191000.description:
Masashi Kurokawa (45), a formidable female CEO who single-handedly built her company into a sprawling empire, ruled her employees with an iron fist, amassing immense wealth in the process. While consumed by an intense loathing for men in general, her sole focus of adoration was her only son, Kazuya.

Kazuya, despite holding the title of senior managing director, was an inept and timid figurehead within the company. Burdened by a mother complex, he harbored secret sexual desires for his own mother.

The balding managing director, a constant target of Masa's disdain, plotted his revenge. He cunningly framed Kazuya for embezzlement, using it as leverage to corner Masa.

"Keep your idiot son out of prison," he sneered, "and you'll become my woman."

Driven by a fierce protectiveness for Kazuya, Masa reluctantly conceded, yet her composure remained unbroken, her will unwavering.

Even the balding managing director's considerable sexual skills failed to easily break her resolve. However, a pivotal incident occurred, gradually chipping away at her defenses, revealing a slowly blossoming femininity...

Tomoko used to single out Keisuke—who sat at the bottom of their mom‑friend “caste”—and bully him behind his back to blow off steam.

One day, on his way home from work, Keisuke caught Kiyoshi tormenting his classmate. He filmed the whole thing and shoved the recording in Tomoko’s face:

“Like mother, like son, huh? lol
If you don’t want me to make this video public,
you’ll become my fuck toy, you old hag lol.”

For the sake of her precious son, Tomoko—though horrified—reluctantly agreed.

In that moment, Keisuke unleashed all his pent‑up resentment, ravaging Tomoko’s mature body as if to settle every score.
Her pride was torn to shreds, and before long, Tomoko found herself drowning in relentless, overwhelming pleasure…

Eiji Igarashi, the advisor of the high‑school volleyball club, made it his daily routine to tease Tamako Tamai (27).

Maho Tsurukawa (46), a former university professor, had her academic career abruptly cut short due to unforeseen circumstances. Redirecting her formidable intellect and passion, she dedicated herself to raising her son, Hikaru, to be an exceptional man.

In his university club, Hikaru endured the presence of Taro, a senior whose intellectual capacity seemed inversely proportional to his family's immense wealth, which had paved his way into the university. Taro's conversation was a relentless barrage of crude and vulgar jokes.

One day, to Hikaru's dismay, Taro insisted on visiting his home. Reluctantly, Hikaru conceded.
Taro's eyes immediately fixated on Maho's alluring presence. "Hey there, Professor," he drawled, a lewd grin spreading across his face. "Heard you used to be a big shot. Impressive! You know, if you were to, uh, entertain me, I could probably convince my old man to set you up with some fancy research gig."

Maho's initial revulsion was immediate. Yet, the dormant embers of her passion for the research she had sacrificed began to glow with renewed intensity. The yearning to return to her life's work grew with each passing day.
And then, a dangerous thought took root:
"Just this once..."
Torn between desperation and disgust, Maho yielded to Taro's crude proposition. However, the sensations that flooded her were unlike anything she had ever imagined, unleashing a torrent of unexpected pleasure...

The Todo clan—renowned exorcists of demonic spirits. Iori, born as a twin alongside her elder sister Sakuya, was entrusted to a branch house of the family and raised apart.

When the once‑in‑a‑century calamity struck, Iori confronted it head‑on—but was overpowered by a suddenly appearing Great Oni of immense might, who branded her with a cursed seal. Her body was wracked by relentless carnal fire, and her spiritual energy began to pour forth as if it were milk… Unable to confess the shame of her submission to anyone, Iori’s despair only deepened.

Then the Great Oni reappeared. His true aim was the potent spiritual power held by the shrine maiden of the Tōdō family.
Gathering her courage and crafting a daring stratagem, Iori succeeded in wounding the demon general.
“As long as I can hold onto my spiritual power, my sister will surely come to exorcise him…!”

Clinging to that hope, Iori fought to withstand the Oni’s onslaught, teetering on the brink of ecstasy. But when the demon’s virile form finally breached her defenses, her resolve shattered in a flood of forbidden pleasure. When palace maid Kochun discovers a shocking secret about the princess of the enemy kingdom married to her emperor, her life is cast into turmoil as she becomes embroiled in palace intrigue surrounding the new empress. A kind yet courageous soul, Kochun vows to remain loyal as the empress’s personal maid, but the storm ahead threatens to smash the fragile peace between the Kingdom of Bansa and the Kingdom of Yufe to pieces…

The elves who dwell in the deep forest have long preserved their peace thanks to bodies impervious to demonic magic and a friendly alliance with humankind.

Princess Katia, the only daughter left behind by her king — who died young of illness — has just announced her engagement to Sir Yulian, Commander of the Knights. The people, who had been leaderless, rejoiced at the news.

However…

With the knightly order summoned to aid humans away from elven lands, General Rotton led a faction of humans in league with the demon-kin and launched a surprise attack on the elf territory. Katia narrowly escaped the village, but her heart ached for the captured townsfolk, and, reckless with hope, she set out alone to plead for peace at General Rotton’s stronghold.

Rotton agreed to free the prisoners — but only in exchange for Katia’s body. Trusting that Sir Yulian would come to her aid, Katia steels herself for Rotton’s cruel regimen of pleasure-based “instruction”…

(Source: Fanza, translated)

When Princess Katia made her escape, a desperate stand was still being made by the royal guards back in the village—among them was a human girl. Her name was Henri. Raised by elves, she too had become one of the Queen’s personal guard.
Against the overwhelming numbers of the human invaders, elf after elf fell under the onslaught. Henri fought on alone, her strength and resolve pushed to the brink.

Just as she steeled herself to accept death, a demon warrior appeared before her. With a single word of sorcery, he cast an enchantment upon Henri, forcing her into a state of induced submission.
Under his spell, she was compelled to duel in shame against the troop’s captain. The once‑pure knight found herself spiraling into uncharted realms of forbidden pleasure…

One day she was assigned what should have been a simple mission: infiltrate a noble’s manor and gather proof of human trafficking. Yet what she witnessed inside was far more disturbing—the brutal “training” of sex slaves—followed by the advances of powerful, brutish men.

Unable to turn away, Tae-Hwa lets himself drift into a moment he never intended, telling himself it is only temporary. As he moves forward, hoping to return to the friendship they once had, he begins to question whether that is truly what he wants.

Then his classmate Yuki Fuwa appears...!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 新米住職さんと不可思議な日々

191056.description:
Linne thought she was merely playing the brand-new VRMMO “Meltis Online,” but when she goes off script and punches her angelic guide, she stumbles upon a hidden event! Suddenly, she’s a Necromancer, befriending monsters and getting stronger than ever. Every chaotic choice leads her to new party members, and eventually, she and her group become the world’s ultimate threat. From one disaster-level mistake to the next, Linne is kicking off a new life and an apocalypse!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.english: I Became a Necromancer After Beating Up My Angel Guide and Accidentally Triggered the Apocalypse
title.native: ガイド役の天使を殴り倒したら、死霊術師になりました ～裏イベントを最速で引き当てた結果、世界が終焉を迎えるそうです～
title.romaji: Guide-yaku no Tenshi wo Naguri Taoshitara, Shiryoujutsushi ni Narimashita: Ura Event wo Saisoku de Hikiateta Kekka, Sekai ga Shuuen wo Mukaeru Sou desu

191057.description:
Kaya Houjou attends a prestigious girls' school. Unable to fit in with her surroundings, she always spends her time alone in the gazebo in the backyard. One day, when cherry blossoms are dancing, she sees a black-haired girl gracefully dancing ballet in the backyard, where no one is supposed to be. Captivated by her free and beautiful appearance, Kaya begins to investigate her true identity...

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime 2025 June issue.

191058.description:
Kanna Niizuma's tendency to bombard anyone she's interested in with questions has made it difficult for her to find a boyfriend. On her way home after being dumped by someone she met on an app, she hears a scream and looks into an alleyway, where she finds her former classmate, Ayumi Hoshi, capturing a woman with her tentacles...

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime 2025 June issue.
synonyms: Teach Me About The Universe, My Baby

title.native: 宇宙を教えてマイベイビー

191060.description:
Miu, a young girl who attended a Halloween event, got separated from her friends and lost consciousness after eating a sweet that caught her eye. When she woke up, she found herself being cared for by a mysterious, spider-like woman...

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime 2025 June issue.

191061.description:
Dentor works at a nursing home where a man of legend is rumored to be. But it turns out he's actually a promising young talent making waves in the mafia. Dentor's assignment is to infiltrate the nursing home where the legendary assassin Omega is in hiding, and snatch the 100 million dollar bounty...!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

191065.description:
Taiga Hiiragi, a delinquent, lived a life consumed by daily brawls. One day, Noel, a genius slime reincarnated from another world, appears before him. When Taiga finds himself in a pinch during a fight, Noel uses his intellect to help him out. Then Noel declares to Taiga, “Slimes and Yankees (delinquents) should go to Tokyo University!!” Noel claims he’s here to help Taiga pass the Tokyo University entrance exam, but…?

(Source: LINE Manga, translated)
synonyms: Slime Blossom: A Reincarnated Genius in a New World
Slime Cherry Blossoms Bloom in Another World
スライム桜は異世界に咲く-復讐転生東大受験 合格率0.0001%-ドラゴン桜公認
Fukushuu Tensei Higashi Daiju Ken Goukakuritsu 0.0001% - Dragon Zakura Kounin

title.native: スライム桜は異世界に咲く
title.romaji: Slime Sakura wa Isekai ni Saku

191066.description:
Park Chun-Jae, a 20-year-old gay man who moved to the city with big dreams of finding a lover. The first thing he did upon arriving in Seoul was install a popular dating app! He went to an amusement park, went on dates at famous restaurants... With these happy fantasies, he went on his first date with a man named 'KAZ' whom he met on a dating app. "Are you sure your nickname is 'Gomdollatte'?" He was surprised by his fair skin, pretty face, and much smaller body. But where did KAZ take him often? A hotel?!

"Uh, we just met..."

"Huh? Isn't this why we met? It's okay. I won't get sick."

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes 4 side story chapters.
synonyms: Didn't We Start by Holding Hands?
手を繋ぐだけじゃなかったの？
เริ่มจากจับมือกันก่อนไม่ใช่เหรอครับ?

191067.description:
Chloe thought Luke's revenge was just, as her own father had killed his father. That is why when she is brought back to the past, she decides to accept her tragic fate. But suddenly and unexpectedly, Luke's most trusted Knight approaches her.

"He won't be able to kill you, so escape as if you're dead."

She is convinced by Luke and decides to flee with him, thinking there will no longer be any obstacles as long as she fakes her own death, until...

"Your life belongs to me."

Chloe and Luke's paths cross again when they meet as the insomniac emperor and the pharmacist who concocts his sleeping pills. With a completely new identity, Chloe no longer looks the same, yet Luke is instinctively drawn to her. Will Chloe be able to escape death and become happy again?

(Source: POCKET COMICS)
synonyms: จักรพรรดิผู้ไม่เคยหลับใหล
O Imperador Não Consegue Mais Dormir

191068.description:
Mikhail, the strongest man in another world, turns into a golden retriever whenever he's around Sena? One day, a door to a dungeon suddenly opens in the basement, and a mysterious man appears.

“Here, we eat chicken whenever something happy or sad happens.”
“Miss… please, take me in as your servant.”

A man who wants to become your servant just because you fed him chicken — can you handle that? As if that wasn’t enough, turns out I’m a descendant of a legendary archmage? Sena’s already confused, but now her sweet little brother joins in with a barrage of unexpected confessions?

And yet… the mukbang must go on. A bond born from chicken — can it transcend the boundaries between fantasy and reality? For those worn out by the spicy chaos of everyday life, get ready for a sweet and savory dungeon romance.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

191069.description:
Abandoned as an infant in the mystical Siuta Forest, Freya knows nothing of her past. Driven to uncover the truth of her origins, she becomes a priestess and embarks on a pilgrimage back to the forest. There, she begins dreaming of a red-haired man named Aran, whose appearance mirrors the kingdom's legendary hero from an ancient mural. As the dreams repeat, Freya starts to suspect they may hold a deeper meaning. Who is this man, and what is the truth behind their mysterious connection?

(Source: Tapas)

191070.description:
Sentenced to death for adultery, Evelyn Cordelia stands before a crowd that calls her a witch.

"Only God knows the truth. I have never done anything to be ashamed of."

Before the blade swings, she sees someone smiling in the crowd... is it her dead husband? When she opens her eyes again, she is transported to a time long before her marriage. Who is her ex-husband who feigned his own death? Who drove her family to ruin? Who accused her of adultery and infidelity? She must find out everything, even if it means she has to become the villainness of her own story.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

title.native: 濡れ衣を着せられたので悪女になります
title.romaji: Nureginu wo Kiserareta no de Akujo ni Narimasu

191071.description:
After beating "The Return of the D-Rank Hunter," the game, Seon-Woo wakes up as the game's NPC, kidnapped by the insomnia-ridden protagonist Jae-Hwi, who demands Seon-Woo become his Mentalist via a one-sided contract. To return to reality, Seon-Woo must unlock the game’s secret ending. Will he make it?

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: 隠しエンディングを生成中です
ภารกิจพิชิตฉากจบลับ

title.native: 転生第八王子の幸せ家族計画
title.romaji: Tensai Dai-hachi Ouji no Shiawase Kazoku Keikaku

191074.description:
A beautiful and successful news anchor, Yeo-Jin's life looks perfect from the outside. But in reality, she's trapped in an unhappy marriage. Not only did her husband have an affair with her close coworker, but he also murdered her parents and stole their company. Yeo-Jin thought her life was over, but when she opened her eyes, she found herself back on her wedding day. Watching her husband and his mistress flirt, Yeo-Jin swears to get her revenge. She will do whatever it takes, even if she must marry her husband's older brother.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: ฉันจะแต่งกับพี่ชายของคุณ

191075.description:
Seyden is the captain of the Paladin’s Order, and it is one of his duties to protect Bellota, the Saintess of the Empire. However, his feelings for her go beyond what duty demands from him. When he discovers that Bellota has been cursed to need a man’s seed in her every full moon, he volunteers to be the one to spend those nights with her. Although Bellota treats Seyden coldly, his determination to protect her and find a way to lift the curse remains unchanged. Will he be able to break this curse before it breaks Bellota’s spirit?

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: คำสาปรักนักบุญสาว

191076.description:
When he woke up, Ji Ran, the son of a rich second generation, found himself lying beside his arch-nemesis from his school days, Qin Man!

Despite reluctantly agreeing to a sponsorship agreement with the green tea black belly enemy, Ji Ran finds his lonely and stubborn heart gradually melting by the occasional tenderness displayed by Qin Man.

(Source: KuaiKan Manhua, translated)
synonyms: My Perfect Enemy Is Finally Broke

191077.description:
A story about a pretty, ditsy ghost and a cold guy. But wait, how is their first meeting in a bathtub?!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

191078.description:
Riyun Adinmir grew up being regarded as the disgrace of the perfect Adinmir family, a fact that deeply shaped her perception of herself. Constantly comparing herself to her relatives and those around her, Riyun considers herself twisted and flawed. Despite this, after three years of suppressing her temperament and enduring life at the Academy, her true character eventually comes to light. However, the consequences take an unexpected turn, diverging from what Riyun had envisioned.

(Source: Naver, translated)

191079.description:
Takeru, an ordinary college student, is in love with his childhood friend and handsome classmate, Yusei. Takeru was initially satisfied with simply fantasizing about their friendship, but things take a sudden turn when Yusei suggests the two of them have sex. After the Yusei and Takeru's passionate tryst, they end up as sex friends, leading Takeru to dread the day things come to an end. Nonetheless, Takeru's mind and body still yearn for Yusei... The two are in love with each other, but can't seem to say it to one another.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: ためいきセックスレモネード

191080.description:
1. VIP Fan Gentei Mesu Ana Kaihou Day (VIPファン限定・雌穴開放デー); COMIC Kuriberon DUMA 2022-10
2. Kyousei Chokyo Gasshuku: Geneki JD Model Ooshiro Saeki (嬌声調教合宿-現役JDモデル 大城冴姫-); COMIC Kuriberon DUMA 2021-10
3. Osu Kurabe: Watashi no Kare to SeFri no Senpai (オス競べ-私の彼とセフレのセンパイ-); COMIC Kuriberon DUMA 2022-04
4-6. Honshou (本性); Comic Kuriberon DUMA 2023-06, 09, 12
7. VIP Fan Gentei Mesu Ana Kaihou Day Encore (VIPファン限定・雌穴開放デー あんこ〜る)
8-9. Bonus
synonyms: VIP Fan Gentei Mesu Ana Kaihou Day
VIPファン限定・雌穴開放デー
Kyousei Chokyo Gasshuku: Geneki JD Model Ooshiro Saeki
嬌声調教合宿-現役JDモデル 大城冴姫-
Osu Kurabe: Watashi no Kare to SeFri no Senpai
オス競べ-私の彼とセフレのセンパイ-

191081.description:
How could I not get curious!? ♥

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in Comic Kairakuten BEAST 2025-04

title.romaji: Sekai no Naka ni Omae dake

191082.description:
Miyako Sayama, a busty high school girl, enrolled in a school with a mandatory club activity rule. She intended to join the swimming club, which she had been a part of in middle school, only to discover that the girls' team had been disbanded. As a result, she joined the boys' swimming club as their manager.
Her looks and figure immediately excited the male members.
However, Miyako soon found herself targeted by the predatory advances of a promiscuous alumnus...

(Source: DLsite, translated)

title.native: 水泳部マネージャーヤリチンOBに喰われる。
title.romaji: Suiei-bu Manager Yarichin OB ni Kuwareru.

191083.description:
Mikogami Miko was a kind student who treated everyone with gentleness. In stark contrast was Futoshi Odakura, a drab, virgin otaku ostracized by the rest of the class.
Through a strange turn of events, Odakura found himself alone with Miko.
Using a dubious "hypnosis" technique he'd learned from a shady online seminar, he managed to have sex with the girl he admired.

(Source: DLsite, translated)

191084.description:
It was the Exterminators—shadowy operatives who have eradicated any threat to humanity, from yokai and extraterrestrials to corrupt organizations. Even today, they continue to purge the world’s darkness.

High‑schooler Momo Oki is one such Exterminator. After classes, she and her junior, Kiiro Shimano, were out hunting yokai. Just as they thought the job was done, Momo’s smartphone buzzed with a new assignment. Scanning the details, she judged it a task she could handle alone. Bidding farewell to Kiiro, she set off solo for the destination.

But when she arrived… it wasn’t yokai at all, but a gathering of a deranged cult calling itself the Arkme Sect.

(Source: DLsite, translated)

title.native: 絶頂へ導くカルト ~JK滅却師は快楽の悦びを身体に刻む~
title.romaji: Zecchou e Michibiku Cult: JK Mekkyakushi wa Kairaku no Yorokobi wo Karada ni Kizamu

191085.description:
Seasoned adventurer Orca Victoria, returning from a quest, was struck by a spell cast by a low‐level mushroom‐type monster. She later discovered it was a charm that imprinted a lewd mark upon her—and resolved to slay the mushroom monster to break the curse…

However, under the influence of that mark, Orca found herself utterly powerless before the low‑level creature…

(Source: DLsite, translated)

191086.description:
It was by the most unexpected twist of fate that our young female swordswoman found herself completely broke. With no worthwhile quests in sight, she finally stumbled upon one boasting an extravagant reward.
Yet when she arrived at the assignment’s location, what awaited her was no ordinary contract—but a bizarre trial laid out by a succubus…

(Source: DLsite, translated)

191087.description:
High school student Ren Nakano's first sexual experience with her boyfriend left her feeling unsatisfied. One day, she ran into Tsukishima, a senior from her high school who had already graduated.

As they caught up, the topic of her first sexual encounter came up. Upon hearing about it, Tsukishima said, "Maybe I can help," and led Ren to a hotel.
There, Ren was shocked to discover that Tsukishima was a futanari. However, she couldn't hide her interest in Tsukishima's futanari cock, which was larger and longer than her boyfriend's.
She was easily persuaded and had the true pleasure of sex imprinted onto her body.

Ren's body became unable to find satisfaction with anyone but her senior. While her boyfriend was away on an overnight job, she invited Tsukishima over. However, her boyfriend's shift ended earlier than expected, and he returned home to find them in the act...

(Source: DLsite, translated)

title.native: 彼氏くんの粗チンじゃ満足出来なくて…
title.romaji: Kareshi-kun no Sochin ja Manzoku Deki Nakute...

title.native: 妄想ランドエスケープ

191089.description:
In the back of an empty library, a story about a boy and girl, secretly flirting...!!
How scandalous!

(Source: Author's Twitter, translated)

Note: Originally published in Betsufure 2024 Jan. issue.

title.native: 鬼のカテキョになりました。

191091.description:
One day, a busty high‑school girl reincarnated into another world obtained the ultra‑low‑drop‑rate item known as the Hypnocker’s Pendulum. By swinging it, anyone can effortlessly cast hypnotic magic—an almost mythical mind‑control artifact, whispered about among collectors as if it might not even exist.

Having only just arrived in this new realm, the busty JK didn’t recognize its true value and promptly sold it to the local adventurer’s supply shop.

The shopkeeper, overjoyed at acquiring this fabled hypnosis device, couldn’t resist testing its power—and so he turned the Pendulum’s magic on the unsuspecting JK.

What fate now awaits her, caught within the thrall of hypnotic enchantment…?

(Source: DLsite, translated)

title.native: ヒプノッカーノフリコ

191092.description:
It was by the most unexpected twist of fate that high‑school girl Shiki Igarashi found herself reborn in another world. Yet her spirit was “super” optimistic:

“Well, if I’ve been reincarnated into a fantasy realm, there’s nothing I can do about it, right~?”

With that cheery shrug, Shiki set off to begin her new life in this strange land.

(Source: DLsite, translated)

title.native: 異世界の堕とし穴~爆乳JKの異世界ライフ~
title.romaji: Isekai no Otoshi Ana: Bakunyuu JK no Isekai Life

191093.description:
Nagomi is often mistaken for a flamboyant girl because of her looks. When she was in high school, she had a crush on Ichihara-san, a gentle teacher who treated her kindly. But when she meets him again as a university student…! Unexpected pure love!

(Source: Manga Park, translated)
synonyms: I want to fall in love with the real you.

title.native: 素顔の君と恋がしたい
title.romaji: Sugao no Kimi to Koi ga Shitai

191094.description:
Yoon-Cheol, a 36-year-old “goose dad” living alone while his wife and daughter study abroad, has endured two years of solitude—but what’s truly driving him mad are the relentless moans coming from the apartment next door. After months of tortured nights, he finally loses it and bangs on his neighbor’s door mid-climax. Bad idea. Seung-Hoon, a bold and mischievous 24-year-old college athlete, isn’t the least bit sorry—in fact, he’s now hell-bent on teasing the uptight older man even more.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Chapter count includes 5 side story chapters.
synonyms: Grill and Savor the Neighbor Goose Dad

title.english: Devouring the Goose Dad Next Door

191095.description:
1. Fanfare Girl (ファンファーレ・ガール)
2. Furui Yakata no Miru Yume wa (古い館の見る夢は)
3. Magical Better Half (マジカル・ベター・ハーフ)
4. Mou Hitotsu no Kisetsu (もうひとつの季節)
5. North Field (ノース・フィールド)
6. Amagakeru Romance Writer (天翔るロマンス・ライター)

title.native: ファンファーレ・ガール

191096.description:
They say you always meet your worst enemies at military reserve training. When Yong-Taek runs into Wu-Chang in the training center’s restroom, he tries to offer a sincere apology for their messy high school past. But Wu-Chang hasn't changed a bit, throwing insults and mocking Yong-Taek’s family until something finally snaps. Yong-Taek decides it’s time for a different kind of "discipline." He never hated Wu-Chang; he just realized that sometimes, the only way to show love is through a very firm, very hard lesson.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: The Marshal Is in the Reserve Force Mobility Training
因縁の相手は予備軍訓練所で出会う〜これは愛のムチだ〜

191097.description:
1. Chiisana Koi no Uta (小さな恋のうた)
2. Hoshi no Furu Sato (星のふる里)
3. Odense Daikanon! (おでんせ大歓音!)
4. Lise to Genshi no Mori (リーゼと原始の森)
5-12. Hijiyama-san Series (ヒジヤマさんシリーズ)
13. Kaku Hito e (描く人へ)

title.native: ヒジヤマさん 星の音 森のうた こうの史代短編集
title.romaji: Hijiyama-san: Hoshi no Oto Mori no Uta - Kouno Fumiyo Tanpenshuu

191098.description:
As an operative of his organization, the protagonist succeeds in capturing an illegal alien and—through interrogation—learns the whereabouts of its comrades.

But when he arrives at the indicated location, it turns out to be nothing more than a human-run factory. Convinced he’s been fed false information, he’s taken aback when the very workers there—secretly in league with the aliens—seize him and drag him away into space.

Now, sold to the highest bidder at an alien-run auction, his fate hangs in the balance… What will become of our hero?

(Source: DLsite, translated)

title.native: 宇宙人専用密輸ルート

191099.description:
It was a sudden turn of events.

The great Demon Lord Levior—who once ruled the world before being sealed away by a hero’s hand—spent centuries shattering that very seal, and now has descended upon the world once more. Chaos and darkness spread across the land. People fell into despair…and prayed for a single ray of light to restore peace to the world…that a hero would appear―――

In a remote frontier village, the girl Sonia awakened as that very hero…yet to her bewilderment, she had grown a penis!? Though stunned, she went along with the village chief’s urgings and set out on her journey…

And along the road she would encounter monsters (slimes), new party members, and…

(Source: DLsite, translated)

title.native: AWAKENING  ふたなり勇者の旅立ち

191100.description:
By outwitting and overwhelming the exorcist Alisa Kisaragi Renou—who had come to purify her—a powerful female incubus secured her dominance.

Bored during the daylight hours, she decides to pay a visit to the school where Alisa now teaches, eager to continue her cruel games. But upon arrival, she discovers not Alisa, but a new female demon‐hunter—one who can still see the incubus even when she fades from view.

Delighted at having found fresh prey, the incubus gleefully inflicts “futanari” upon this unsuspecting exorcist… but what will happen next…?

(Source: DLsite, translated)

title.native: 退魔師・杠葉さくらの敗北～授業中ふたなり凌化編～
title.romaji: Taimashi Yuzuriha Sakura no Haiboku: Jugyouchuu Futanari Ryouka-hen

191101.description:
Betrayed by his guild and defeated by a top player, Hyrkan loses everything. Before he can get revenge, a fatal accident ends his life—only for him to wake up years in the past, back at the start of Warlord. Now, with his memories intact, he’s determined to rise to the top alone. But in a game where power means everything, can he truly survive without any allies? The Emperor of Solo Play is back, and this time, he’s playing by his own rules.

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: ราชาแห่งโซโล่เพลเยอร์

191103.description:
Driven by a desperate need for money, two college students volunteer to step into Lezhin's darkest sanctuary. Awaiting them is a Doctor whose 'Medical Exams' are as thorough as they are deviant. From physicals and stimulation to various 'treatments', no desire is left unexplored. Surrender to your deepest cravings at the Lezhin Secret Club. All are welcome to witness the corruption.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Part of Lezhin's Bimilkeulleom Danpyeonseon (비밀클럽 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: [ヒミツ倶楽部短編選] 欲望に溺れた男たち

title.native: 俺の母さんは見知らぬ男にレ〇プされる(人妻ものじゃないよ!)
title.romaji: Ore no Kaasan wa Mishinaru Otoko ni Rape Sareru (Hitozuma mono Janai yo!)

191107.description:
“To Defeat the Suddenly‑Appearing Monster Legion ‘Waruizon,’ Magical Girl Rising Storm Fights On!”

(Source: DLsite, translated)

title.native: 魔法少女ライジングストーム

191108.description:
Shiki Igarashi, a high‑school girl reborn into another world, has been making her living as an adventurer. One day, she dared to delve into a perilous dungeon…
However, midway through her exploration, she triggered a trap set by a succubus and found herself bound hand and foot.
What fate now awaits her, trapped and helpless within the labyrinth…!?

(Source: DLsite, translated)

191109.description:
Leo and Sui have been "engaged" since their parents introduced them in childhood... but in the years that followed, they were barely even friends. That is, until much later, when Leo's parents passed away and he was adopted into Sui's family. As the "brothers" grew closer in adulthood, they could no longer resist their attraction to each other... and yet, they remain unwed. Ignoring the pressure from Sui's parents to tie the knot, the two live together in blissful sin. Despite Leo's encouragement, Sui resists the urgency of marriage, hoping to keep his adorable betrothed all to himself just a little longer...

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

Note: Original serialization ran for seven chapters. In the volume release, Chapters 6 and 7 were combined as Chapter 6.

191110.description:
After discovering her "friend" Min-Chae was only using her to clean up her own image, bullied high schooler Se-Yo’s life takes a dramatic turn when an accident leaves her in the body of a beautiful coma patient named Kkotbi! The deity responsible for the body swap offers her a deal: fulfill Kkotbi's destiny by becoming an idol within a year or lose everything. Now Se-Yo must learn the ropes of K-pop stardom while dealing with a jealous Min-Chae, who has no idea the gorgeous new girl is actually her former friend who knows all about her dark past.

(Source: WEBTOON)

191111.description:
After a rough day and a run-in with a missing dog, overworked office worker Umi Seo wakes up to a surreal nightmare: she’s trapped in the body of her boss’s beloved pet. By day, Umi is a dog. By night, she’s back to being human. Forced to live under one roof with the aloof CEO, Chahyeon Baek, the two begin to grow closer in the most unexpected way. But can Umi ever return to her normal life for good? Or will she be stuck living on a leash forever?

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: Woke Up as the CEO’s Dog

191112.description:
Min-U Seo, a struggling nobody, never thought he'd inherit anything, especially not from the mother who abandoned him. However, what he received was beyond anything he could have imagined... A kindergarten for divine beasts! Will Min-U be able to look after these magical children as their new teacher?

(Source: WEBTOON)

191113.description: Note: Originally published in Comic Yuri-Hime 2023 April issue.

title.native: もう俺だけの女じゃない母さん
title.romaji: Mou Ore dake no Onna ja Nai Kaa-san

191115.description:
Twenty-four-year-old job seeker Im Yu-Ha returns to her parents' house in tears after a series of job rejections following her college graduation. There, she encounters Ji Min-Gyu, the youngest son of the homeowners and the black sheep of the family. At their first meeting, he rudely asks, "Are you the new helper who moved in today?" and behaves disrespectfully. Under the same roof with the immature young master she never wanted to get involved with, ro...mance? Absolutely not! Let's keep the line we should never cross between you and me.

(Source: Naver, translated)

191116.description:
Namia, the magic-scroll-writing genius, gets taken advantage of by everyone—from her lazy boss to her greedy family. But when she uses her knowledge of this novel to save the life of Prince Kiaros, it’s time for her life to turn around. Those who used her will finally get what’s coming to them, while Namia’s skills and good deeds are finally recognized and rewarded. But little does she know that her new assistant is really the prince in disguise, and someone is still trying to kill him!

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: This Low-Rank Civil Servant Wants to Get Promoted
The Low-Ranking Civil Servant Wants to Achieve Success

title.english: Low-Level Civil Servant Wants to Climb the Social Ladder

191117.description:
Humanity’s technology leapt forward the moment we successfully made contact with extraterrestrials—space travel became freely accessible to anyone. But with that progress came a surge in alien‑related crime. In the midst of it all, a new profession took hold among young adventurers:

The alien specialist bounty hunter.

Our protagonist, working as usual out in space, detected a massive signal on his scanners. Investigating, he found a large vessel—but when he cross‑referenced it with the Hunter’s Forum, he discovered it was flagged as an “Anti‑Alliance” ship. Sensing a high‑value target, he boarded…only to realize too late that the entire setup was a trap designed to capture unsuspecting hunters.

(Source: DLsite, translated)

title.native: 宇宙人専用公衆トイレ

191118.description:
Three boys from class were practicing hypnotic magic in an empty classroom after school—once every other student had gone home.
Just then, one of the “gyaru” in their grade poked her head in to retrieve something she’d forgotten. Spotting them, she grinned and said, “Hey, can you cast that hypnosis trick on me, too?”
Caught off‑guard and unable to admit it was just a joke, the boys went through the motions of chanting and waving their hands as if performing a real spell…

But to their astonishment, the gal proved unbelievably susceptible to their “hypnosis.” She melted under their makeshift ritual far more easily than anyone else ever had.

(Source: DLsite, translated)

title.native: 放課後に催○術の練習してたらクラスのギャルが来た。
title.romaji: Houkago Saimin Jutsu no Renshuu Shitetara Class no Gal ga Kita.

191119.description:
Eden City—a place where all the world's pleasures converge. Using her deceased twin's diary, Sarin searches the city for a certain man. During her search she encounters Owen, the king who rules over Eden City. Despite his oppressive demeanor and scrutinizing gaze, Sarin chooses to stay by his side. However, Sarin herself is hiding a secret...

(Source: Manta)

191120.description:
Magical Girl Rising Storm, the mysterious protector of the city’s peace, one day caught wind of a rumor: members of an evil organization were hiding among ordinary civilians and causing trouble.
Believing that even if she transformed she’d be immediately suspected and thus unable to uncover their trail, she chose to investigate in her civilian guise.
Arriving at the rumored location, she found nothing more sinister than a part‑time worker offering drink samples.

“Just a sampling gig? How misleading…”

With a shrug, she accepted a cup and took a sip—only to discover that the drink had been spiked with a potent aphrodisiac.
Before she could react, the untransformed magical girl was ushered off into the back room. What fate now awaits Rising Storm in her powerless state…?

(Source: DLsite, translated)

title.native: 変身前魔法少女が知らぬ間に悪の組織のセクシービデオに出演してたお話。
title.romaji: Henshin Mae Mahou Shoujo ga Shiranumani Aku no Soshiki no Sexy Video ni Shutsuen Shiteta Ohanashi.

191121.description:
“Let’s turn you into a stain on these sheets too, Hero~♪”

Lost on his journey, a young hero wanders off the path. Suddenly, a Sister appears and guides him to a nearby church. Inside, he finds boys and girls who have left their families living together in peaceful harmony. Seeing their cheerful camaraderie, the hero breathes a sigh of relief.
But this Sister harbors a terrifying secret: she is in fact a succubus who lures unsuspecting male travelers into her church, drains every drop of their life‐energy, and transforms them into stains upon her sheets.
Before he can react, the hero is bound just as swiftly as those who came before him. Will he too be added to the Sister‐Succubus’s ever‐growing collection of sheet stains…?

(Source: DLsite, translated)

title.native: 懺悔搾り～シスターサキュバスに謝罪搾精を強要されるお話～
title.romaji: Zange Shibori: Sister Succubus ni Shazai Sakusei wo Kyouyou Sareru Ohanashi

191122.description:
Shiki Igarashi, a high‑school girl reborn into another world and making her living as an adventurer, one day fell violently ill after eating the lunch a party member had given her.
Unable to hold it in any longer, Shiki stole away behind some bushes—only to lose control and soil herself in secret. Unbeknownst to her, a hidden camera recorded every humiliating moment…
Days later, the photos surfaced as blackmail, threatening to expose her ordeal. What fate now awaits Shiki, trapped by the shame of those damning images…?!

(Source: DLsite, translated)

title.native: 大きな証拠。 爆乳JKの異世界ライフ
title.romaji: Oo Kina Syouko.: Bakunyuu JK no Isekai Life

191123.description:
Magical Girl Rising Storm, the defender of global peace, stood face‑to‑face with a suddenly appeared, fly‑shaped fiend.
With powerful magic, Rising Storm swiftly overwhelmed her enemy—yet in a fleeting lapse she was struck by a strange beam that induced excruciating abdominal pain.
Now wracked by agony and unable to continue the fight, the fate of the world’s guardian hangs in the balance… what will become of Rising Storm?!

(Source: DLsite, translated)

title.native: 魔法少女ライジングストームVS蝿怪人ブリスカー
title.romaji: Mahou Shoujo Rising Storm VS Hae Kaijin Brisker

191124.description:
Shouta, squeezed mercilessly in a packed commuter train, experienced an unexpected stroke of “pervy luck” when the train braked suddenly—and his face ended up buried in the ample chest of the busty high‑school girl standing beside him.
Unable to shake the memory of that moment, Shouta made his way home still flushed with excitement.
Before long, his sister arrived—but she wasn’t alone. Accompanying her was the very same busty JK he’d met on the train: Shiki Igarashi.
To Shouta’s astonishment, Shiki announced she would be staying over that night…

His emotions spun into a whirlwind of surprise and nervous anticipation, yet he clung to what little composure he could muster.
Later, in the bathroom, he caught sight of her discarded panties—and found himself getting aroused all over again…

(Source: DLsite, translated)

title.native: サキュバスの大冒険～勇者様の仲間になったフリして姫様との初夜に無理矢理オチン〇ン寝取っちゃったお話
title.romaji: Succubus no Daibouken: Yuusha-sama no Nakama ni Natta Furi shite Hime-sama to no Shoya ni Muriyari Ochinchin Netochatta Ohanashi

191126.description:
Hiiragi is the elegant class president, and Mao is the violent delinquent student. Everyone at the academy thinks they have no connection to each other... But in reality, they're tied together by a codependent relationship. Mao's brute attitude is a facade to keep others away from her, so only Master Hiiragi can claim her as his own.

(Source: Irodori Comics)

title.native: そして彼女は燃えゆく~ヤンデレご主人様に絶対服従~
title.romaji: Kanojo wa Moeyuku:  Yandere Goshujin-sama ni Zettai Fukujuu

191127.description:
Born to a wolf-shifter and a lion-shifter, Chloe knows she'll be a predator like no other. So she's got no idea what to do when she one day shifts into… a bunny! Even worse, Chloe then realizes she’s also in a novel, one where her family’s to be killed due to a series of misunderstandings. Determined to save her parents, Chloe sets out to unravel the lies and bring peace to her family. But can Chloe uncover the truth while keeping her transformation unknown? Or will this bunny be bested by fate?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: A Rabbit? No Way, I'm Clearly a Beast!
A Rabbit? Anyone Can See It's a Beast

title.english: I'm a Beast, Not a Bunny!

191129.description:
A booklet packaged with Fellows! volume 9 at select stores. It's an anthology of one-shots from 13 Fellows! collaborators focusing on the theme cheongsam (type of Chinese dress).

(Source: Natalie, translated)

191130.description:
Veterinarian Kim Ohjin was unexpectedly summoned by a dragon. After successfully treating the dragon's pet, he returns home... only to find himself in another world. "Animals in another world are still animals, right?" I was a vet barely scraping by in the real world, but now, in this strange new world, I'm a renowned doctor? With my old clinic on the verge of closing, I'm setting my sights on a new opportunity—my second clinic, and, hopefully, a big success!

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: Kim Ohjin's Adventures with Strange Animals
Kim Oh-jin and the Strange Animals
Kim Oh-jin and The Strange Beasts

191131.description:
Akashi Chika, a lethargic and cool high school student, spends his boring day-to-day life peacefully, with the exception of a certain dream that he often sees. A dream about a girl, a very neat and clean girl wearing a kimono. Without even knowing this girl's name, Chika can't help but feel a very nostalgic feeling towards her.

While he's living his daily life with this matters still in his mind, a grotesque being, completely out of this world appears and fundamentally overturns Chika's ordinary days, as he starts to recall his past memories which have been sealed...

191132.description:
In an era when various demons run rampant, Akira, who can communicate with demons, tries bring peace to the world. However, his territory was attacked by bandits. Akira purposely allowed himself to be captured in order to get back what had been stolen, but...

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

191133.description:
“I am from the afterlife.”

Lee Do-Jin, who needs a huge amount of money to pay for his younger brother’s medical expenses. He contacts her after being led by a suspicious business card he found by chance, and meets a strange silver-haired woman named Cha-Sa at the meeting place. She offers Do-Jin a job as an afterlife dispatch worker to stop the predator Mokdugi, who preys on the souls of humans who have accumulated evil deeds…

(Source: Naver, translated)

191134.description:
Rieul toils away at her office job until a sudden dungeon break ends her life. But instead of dying, she wakes up three years in the past with a second chance at life. Determined to change her fate, she reopens her late grandmother’s cafe. But the moment she gets to work, she awakens as a Cafe Owner-class hunter... with a talking cat agent named Mieum! Between brewing coffee and clearing system quests, Rieul’s new life is anything but peaceful. Has her quiet dream already gone up in smoke?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The SSS-Class Cafe in Front of the Dungeon

191135.description:
Mel, a young boy, gets involved with the forbidden terrorist organization "Brahma". As a result, his life is put in danger by a humanoid weapon. A mysterious man named Chateau saves him from this crisis. But who is he really?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

191136.description:
The story centers on college student Ayato Hirose. He is popular with his classmates, good-looking, and has great communication skills. He enjoys a fulfilling university life, until an unexpected incident happens...

After meeting Sakura Itou, who studies in the same university as him, he is forced to join her death metal band. What will happen to Ayato's peaceful university life?

(Source: Anime News Network, edited)

title.native: Beast of Man ～デスメタル魔人伝 地獄のライブ拷問黙示録～
title.romaji: Beast Man: Death Metal Majin-den - Jigoku no Live Goumon Mokushiroku

191137.description:
Orphaned at a young age, Woo Jung-Won grew up neglected in an orphanage. One day, drowning in debt, the director decides to sell him off. Luckily, Kwon Jun-Seo, a powerful mafioso, arrives just in time—to collect his money. But when he sees Jung-Won being manhandled, something in him shifts. On a whim, he saves the poor boy. For the first time in his life, Jung-Won sees a ray of hope in his dark and bleak world. And from that moment, a flower of hope blooms within him—bright and powerful. But is that flower truly something beautiful? Or is it the beginning of something far more sinister?

(Source: Lezhin US)

191138.description:
Three high school girls took on a well-compensated clinical trial without suspicion, readily consuming the provided medication.

Under the drug's influence, they unknowingly shed their inhibitions and sense of self.

A female police officer, having caught wind of suspicious rumors, infiltrated the same clinical trial as an undercover investigator.

Just as she obtained irrefutable evidence, she was discovered and apprehended by the staff...

(Source: DLsite, translated)

title.native: -人格排泄-人生終了治験モニター
title.romaji: Jinkaku Haisetsu: Jinsei Shuuryou Chiken Monitor

191139.description:
Humanity's technology advanced dramatically after contact with extraterrestrial life, ushering in an era where anyone could freely travel to space.
This was no different for the aliens, and the number of those wishing to visit Earth for tourism, business, or even immigration increased daily.

Futaba Narumiya, a high school girl with a strong interest in male genitalia, learned from a classmate one day about an "aesthetics salon where you can experience alien male genitalia" run by aliens.
Without hesitation, she made a reservation to experience this unique salon...

(Source: DLsite, translated)

title.native: ふたなり体験エステサロン。

191140.description:
Seasoned adventurer Ravi Fodrick has uncovered the legendary weapon—the Holy Sword Mara Blade. But to claim it, she must first overcome its trial and earn the blade’s own approval.
“I’ll clear this in no time!” she declares, brimming with confidence as she steps into the challenge. What she doesn’t know is that this trial is actually a dungeon littered with countless traps—more accurately, erotic traps—awaiting her every turn…

(Source: DLsite, translated)

title.native: セイケンの試練 エロトラップダンジョンなんて聞いて無い!?
title.romaji: Seiken no Shiren Ero Trap Dungeon nante Kiitenai!?

title.romaji: Jakyou Sister ni Nyotaika sare Ochinchin wo Bosshuu sareru Ohanashi

191142.description:
It's a story about a crossdressing cosplayer who gets mistaken for a girl and is feminized by a futanari woman.

(Source: DLsite, translated)

title.native: メスイキスイッチ こんな可愛い子が男の子な訳ない‼︎
title.romaji: Switch Konna Kawaii Ko ga Otokonoko na Wake Nai‼ ︎

191143.description:
The protagonist, at the request of a junior member of the manga club, ended up drawing a comic featuring only explicit exposure for a doujinshi convention.
Stuck for ideas, the protagonist tried exposing themselves as an experiment.
They were then discovered by the junior, and before they knew it, they were participating in the doujinshi convention while exposing themselves as well.

(Source: DLsite, translated)

191144.description:
At the request of a junior member of the Manga Research Club, the protagonist has once again been commissioned to create an exhibitionism‑themed manga for an upcoming doujinshi convention.
This time, in order to gather fresh material, he decides to travel to a city that has been designated as a “special zone” where residents are legally permitted to live entirely naked.

(Source: DLsite, translated)

191145.description:
The young woman sets off for a ryokan where she can expose herself without restraint.
Hungry for even more excitement, she activates a mysterious device and is suddenly whisked away into the toilet of an entirely unfamiliar location.

(Source: DLsite, translated)

title.native: 旅館からうろうろ露出する
転生したら捨てられたが、拾われて楽しく生きています。
title.romaji: Tensei Shitara Suterareta ga, Hirowarete Tanoshiku Ikiteimasu

191147.description:
After being kidnapped by goblins at the age of three, young Al is rescued thanks to his grandfather's bright and powerful magic, something Al had never witnessed before. From then on, Al became fascinated with magic and learned everything he could about it. But the path to mastering magic is far from easy. Even after 12 years of arduous training and preparation, Al's journey is only just getting started! Now that he's an official adventurer, Al is ready to travel across the land in hopes of finding the rare, ancient document known as the “Book of Spells.”

As Al begins his adventure, he quickly finds that his use of magic isn't quite standard. Will his unique techniques and passion for spells lead him down the path of a hero, or will his quest end before it can truly begin?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.english: Al the Adventurer: That Magic Shouldn't Work!
title.native: 冒険者アル あいつの魔法はおかしい
title.romaji: Boukensha Al: Aitsu no Mahou wa Okashii

191148.description:
After being kidnapped by goblins at the age of three, young Al is rescued thanks to his grandfather's bright and powerful magic, something Al had never witnessed before. From then on, Al became fascinated with magic and learned everything he could about it. But the path to mastering magic is far from easy. title.romaji: Mofu Mofu to Tanoshimu Mujintou Nonbiri Kaitaku Life: VRMMO de Bocchi wo Mankitsu Suru Hazu ga, Zen Player ni Chuumoku Sareteiru Mitai desu

191150.description:
Three years have passed since the battle to liberate Knightley, and Ryo, now conferred the title of head duke, is living his best life. He spends his days going between Crystal Palace and the Forest of Rondo, leisurely farming and practicing his alchemy. But the life of a nobleman proves troublesome when he’s ordered to join a diplomatic delegation headed to the faraway Western Provinces. As if that’s not enough, the imperial representative is Rupert VI, his former foe and the previous emperor! Even worse, when they finally reach the Western Provinces, they find that the lands are teeming with malevolent creatures like vampires and demons. Despite their mutual distrust, Ryo and Rupert VI must work together to protect the delegation from the monsters and plots lurking in the Western Provinces.

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.english: The Water Magician: The Western Provinces Arc
title.native: 水属性の魔法使い　第二部　西方諸国編
title.romaji: Mizu Zokusei no Mahou Tsukai Dai Ni-bu: Seihou Shokoku-hen

191151.description:
"So, what do you think about my brother?"

One day, out of nowhere, a charming princess appeared in the life of Claire, the mistreated protagonist of an unknown author's work. Princess Yuri, without any prior connection, unexpectedly proposed that Claire marry her brother—known as the empire's most eligible bachelor. Overwhelmed by the princess's stubbornness, which not even the emperor could sway, Claire found herself in a contract engagement with the second prince.

"I just want you to play along until Princess Yuri is satisfied. I'll make sure you're compensated accordingly."

As Claire waited for the contract to end, Prince Raymond began to approach her. Why would someone who is only tied to her by a contract...?

"I don't want to let you go. I feel like locking you away so you can't leave."

For Claire, who fears both giving and receiving love, the wave of affection from her potential in-laws has only just begun.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.native: 水属性の魔法使い 第三部 東方諸国編
title.romaji: Mizu Zokusei no Mahou Tsukai Dai San-bu: Touhou Shokoku-hen

191153.description: Mochita is an alien who travels to Earth in order to conquer that planet but the first person he bumps with is Issei, who already has some aliens at his house. Will this meeting with Issei change Mochita's plans?

title.romaji: Neko to Ryuu: Ibun - Shichi Eiyuu no Tabidachi

191156.description:
Akabane Haru is an ordinary high school student who doesn't really want to stand out. By chance, he becomes part of the school idol group "Mote Club" at his high school.

(Source: Wikipedia, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes 4 extras.

2. Isshoku Ippako (イッショクイッパコ, A Warm Meal and a Bang); Comic Kairakuten BEAST 2022-01

191158.description:
“I’ll never love you.”

Unused to humans, Abigail panics when her new husband declares that he’ll never love her on the first night of their political marriage. Does that mean she’s not allowed to eat?!

A new twist on the food-based romance tale, starring an earl’s daughter who was the Monster King in her previous life! After years of neglect by her old family, Abigail will charm her sincere military husband and his household one bite at a time and find her happy ending!

(Source: Cross Infinite World)

title.english: Dinners with My Darling: How the Former Monster King Ate Her Way to Happiness
title.native: 愛さないといわれましても ～元魔王の伯爵令嬢は生真面目軍人に餌付けをされて幸せになる～
title.romaji: Aisanai to Iwaremashitemo: Moto Maou no Hakushaku Reijou wa Kimajime Gunjin ni Ezuke wo Sarete Shiawase ni Naru

191159.description:
Will your destined girlfriend arrive on a white horse?

(Source: Asuka, translated)
synonyms: Lady of Destiny on White Horse

191160.description:
The Valdias are a seemingly normal family of nobles that no one would expect to face a future full of death and condemnation—a fate which is about to be rewritten. After a mysterious accident, former salaryman and avid gamer Hajime Kanda wakes up as their eldest child, Reid, in the world of an otome game he once fully cleared. And he knows the terrible future that awaits them all. Reid may have been a petty villain in the main story, but he’s got exceptional stats that will help him grow into a total beast. The hard part will be avoiding the conflict to come, and doing that means bringing the family together again. He’s just got to be sweet to his younger sister, get in his father’s good graces, and cure his mother’s terminal illness, of course. Should be simple enough, right? Well, Reid’s determined to save his family from a dark fate, and he’s going to do it by playing by the rules!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title.english: The Petty Villain Plays by the Rules: Rewriting This Otome Game with Honest Work!

191165.description:
"The day after I slept with you, I... can't get an erection."

College student Park Ha-Min is a self-made nerd who wants to be present and absent among his peers. The reason Ha-Min is sensitive to his own presence is because he is actually a vampire who hides his identity! Ha-Min, who attended the opening ceremony against his will, naturally gets noticed by Ryu Tae-Ha, the most popular person in the department... Things spiral when Jae-Jeong discovers their parents are having an affair. And, turns out, A-Rin just learned about their affair too. As he lay dying, Gigantiana softly whispered, "I will be resurrected in 42 years and bring destruction to this world." 42 years later, Joonwu reincarnates into the body of another person, namesake Joonwu Kim, who has a young teenage physique. A moment to rejoice for a new peaceful world is short-lived. Joonwu becomes distraught, witnessing the subjugation system and Hunter's Law that he and his cohorts had built on their bloodshed and sacrifices in disorder. With this state, Gigantiana's resurrection will bring devastation to this world.

An aspiring street basketball player longs to go pro. To fulfill his dream, he joins a team of street basketball players. What challenges will await him as he battles in the streets? Will he be able to make his dreams of going pro come true?!

Quinn Reyes' mother had always warned her, "your stepfather comes from a prestigious family, your step brother is a genius, and your younger sister is a top student at the best school, you, a country bumpkin must not embarrass them." Meanwhile, the upper circles of the Capital, received a warning from the powerful and untouchable Young Master Jayden, "My wife is clueless about high society and has a terrible temper. Be patient with her." But one day, while investigating a certain legendary figure, Young Master Jayden’s subordinates unearthed one of the many hidden identities of this so-called clueless country girl… and fell into stunned silence.

After learning that he can make money by clearing a full-dive VR game called Prophecy Online, Ray Endo bets his life on the game in hopes of striking it rich. When he successfully clears the game, it suddenly announces its shutdown. However, days later, the world is on the brink of destruction by the same monsters from Prophecy Online. As the only person who has cleared the game and knows its ins and outs, Ray decides to seize this opportunity and profit from his power and knowledge.

Yoo Jinwon, a specialist in surgical operations, receives a request to perform a secret surgery from Seong Wooje, the chairman of South Korea's largest corporation, the Seongil Group. At long last, the opportunity for revenge has arrived! Can Yoo Jinwon not only conquer Seongil Seoul Hospital but also seize control of the entire Seongil Group with just a scalpel? A young woman with a deep-seated desire for exhibitionism stumbles upon a mysterious realm through a hidden door in the closet of her apartment. There, in this strange new world, she discovers a place where her longing to expose herself can finally be fulfilled. Choosing to abandon her humanity, she willingly begins a fully nude life as livestock, ready to be milked.

(Source: DLsite, translated)

191254.description:
Ji-Yeon Kim, a college student on a leave of absence, was living an ordinary life until she found herself possessed into a romance novel her friend had shown her: The Saint's Flower. She became Iola, a girl who appeared halfway through the book. The world of the novel, centered around the saintly heroine and her romantic lead, was not meant for her. Still, she thought that becoming a character in a story might bring her happiness—just like the protagonist of a novel would.

But everyone hurled hatred at her. They despised her. They called her Iola, the wicked woman who tormented the heroine—a false saint. But the truth was different. Iola herself was the true saint.

Blessed by the divine, she returns to the very beginning. This time, she no longer needs her family, those who hate her, the title of Saint, or even the fiancé she once loved. She will walk a different path than before.

"Even if this world tries to turn me into a villainess, I don’t care. I will survive and I will find happiness!"

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Secret Love Affair Between a Former Saint and a Dark Hero

191255.description:
Baek Seung-Hyun has lived in the shadows his whole life, nothing more than the deadly right hand of yakuza boss Shin Jae-Il. But now, Jae-Il is married. And Seung-Hyun, for the first time in years, is left behind. Drifting through empty streets on the night after the wedding, Seung-Hyun crosses paths with Yuta, a delicate ghost from his time in Japan. But what should have been a quiet reunion over a drink turns sharp fast. Yuta’s sweetness curdles, his words cut deep, and before Seung-Hyun can make sense of it everything begins to burn. Uninvited and unrelenting, Yuta storms into his life, dragging with him the weight of the past and something far more dangerous. Seung-Hyun begins to fear that dawn, when it comes, won’t bring light. Only fire.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

191257.description:
At school, Chisato is a little “slower” than others, but she doesn't mind spending going through life at her own pace. However, when she becomes a member of the school festival committee, her inability to explain herself to others causes trouble with her classmates… Unable to handle the cold disdain of her classmates, Chisato finds herself unwilling to go to school anymore. Can she find a way out…?

(Source: Sho-Comi, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a two-chapter side story.

191258.description:
Maho always had top grades all through junior high. However, when she entered high school, no matter how hard she tried, she could not keep up with her classes. And because it's a private all-girls school, she was surrounded by “winners” who had been born into wealthy families. Maho, who grew up in an ordinary household, acted as if her family was rich, too, but inside she was filled with a sense of inferiority. Then one day, Maho's classmates found out about her lie…? It all started with a trivial incident, but it blew up until she can't go to school anymore. It's a nightmare situation that anyone might face… This is the second volume of a highly popular series that sharply depicts girls who are unable to go to school!

(Source: Sho-Comi, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes a one-shot.

Jae-Won, a small-time DIY trader, wins the lottery, but wakes up inside a web novel after a car crash. To return home to his prize money, he must help the male and female leads get their happily ever after, but why do all the handsome male lead candidates seem more interested in him than the heroine?

(Source: Manta)

191263.description:
Seo Yeo-Rin's happy love life ended when she discovered her beloved boyfriend had been cheating on her. Heartbroken, she wandered about aimlessly and almost fell into a frozen river, narrowly escaping death thanks to Jung Yeon-Seok, a handsome stranger. Little did she know that she'd meet him again while visiting her friends in Beijing, although... she doesn't recognize him at all! Will their meeting bring Yeo-Rin the happiness she never got or bring further pain to past scars?

(Source: Tapas)

191266.description:
A goblin lives in Cheonuri, a village in the mountains that no one knows about. After his grandmother, his only family member, passes away, Seung-Hyo goes to the health center in the rural village of Cheonuri to console his empty heart. As soon as he arrives at Cheonuri, Seung-Hyo gets lost and meets Bon-Gi, a young man from the village, who unexpectedly helps her. However, Bon-Gi, who has a cold attitude despite helping her, eventually tells Seung-Hyo to leave the village as soon as possible.

"Do you believe that there are beings other than humans, Seung-Hyo?"

The secret hidden in the peaceful atmosphere of the village and the humble and kind village people is gradually revealed, and Bon-Gi reaches out to help Seung-Hyo, who is confused...

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

191269.description:
Company employee Sano Jyu, who had a frail constitution, always had a sensation of heat inside his body. Then, he collapses due to the combination of a busy season and an outburst of fever. Then the goddess appears and tells him. You have made a mistake in the world in which you should be born. The cause of the fever is magical power, and he was born with magical power in a world without magical power.
 Itsuki is reborn in another world with a healthy body and more magical power than any other person, just as he wished, thanks to the power of the goddess. And with the legendary magical beast born from the egg he was given as his partner, he begins his second life as an adventurer...

191270.description: A serious and uptight male high school student becomes a girl in another world...!? Cattleya Lanoquid is a girl from another world who longs for magic. On her 16th birthday, her mother tells her that the way to save their household finances is to... get excited...!? However, Cattleya was actually Ranka Harumigawa, a neat and serious male high school student in his past life!! Ranka (Cattleya) wants to become a respectable adult, but is torn between that desire and his hidden desires...!!

191272.description:
Al and Milo are classmates, next-door neighbors and have known each other since childhood. Milo is straightforward and honest, while Al is always carefree and it's hard to tell what's on his mind. Strangely enough, they have spent their entire lives together. Just before the holiday season, Al invites Milo to come with him on a solo trip. Milo is a bit confused by the sudden invitation, but he has no reason to refuse and accepts it without hesitation. The destination turns out to be a place they had previously visited with their families as children. When asked about the reason for the trip, Al is constantly evasive and seems to be hiding something...

(Source: Ichijinsha, translated)

191280.description:
Anthology of short stories based on Vento Aureo, the fifth part of the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series. Contains 7 short stories about various members of Passione, most notably La Squadra Esecuzioni.

1. Noraneko wa Harukaze to Saru (野良猫は春風と去る) [Ballad Kitaguni]
After learning of Formaggio's death, Illuso visits his room and finds the cat he left behind. Illuso fondly remembers the days he spent with Formaggio and the cat.

2. Ore Jiman no Hari to Ito (オレ自慢の針と糸) [Yoshihito Okita]
While trying on a new suit, Prosciutto is held at gunpoint by Filo, one of Passione's associates. During Prosciutto's assassination of Filo's brother, Ago, his understudy Pesci had damaged and stolen one of the brothers' matching suits in a fit of petty anger. Filo demands his brother's jacket, threatening to assassinate the two assassins.

3. Oya no Kokoro Ko Shirazu no Maki (親の心子知らずの巻) [Ballad Kitaguni]
Melone's assassination of Amaretti Lucano goes awry when Baby Face's spawn inherits a kind disposition from its newest mother, Lucano's housekeeper. With help from Ghiaccio, Melone attempts to convince his Stand's child to kill, stumbling across its mother's true nature in the process.

4. Gang-gawa no Shounin (ギャング側の証人) [Keiji Andou]
Passione, still a growing force within Italy, faces a grave threat to its existence: famous prosecutor Gilberto Falco aims to expose 32 of their members in court, and deal a crushing blow to the boss's influence in the process. Though Tizzano is tasked with assisting the defense by any means necessary, Squalo is ordered to kill him at the trial's conclusion.

5. Risotto Nero wa Kansatsu Suru (リゾット・ネエロは観察する) [Ayato Toya]
With his team on the verge of collapse under the boss's rule, Risotto Nero decides to undertake the latest assassination mission himself. His target is Rossi Gallignani, a member of the city council whose bad habits include dealings with rival organizations. Infiltrating the politician's early Christmas party, Risotto prepares to strike—but during a sudden blackout, Rossi disappears, leaving the nearby "unopenable door" as Risotto's only clue.

6. Cioccolata, Inu wo Kau (チョコラータ、犬を飼う) [Denkieidou]
Cioccolata takes in a police officer's dog after disposing of its owner, ordering Secco to train it. It becomes difficult to tell owner from pet in the bizarre slice-of-life that follows.

7. Gelato ga Tokete Shimau Mae ni (ジェラートが溶けてしまう前に) [Kira Tsukinami]
Gelato, a man who loves sweets and murder. Sorbet, forever his supporter. The two have a chat while driving toward their next mission. What awaits them is ruin.

In a brothel somewhere in the Kansai region, men with all sorts of sexual fetishes and desires come as customers. The women they serve are Mayumi, a plump woman with boundless cheerfulness; Chinatsu, a former delinquent who is popular with submissive men; and Shio, a slim beauty with a hint of culture. The plot is set in motion when an old customer passes away in front of their brothel.

Reiji Iwanami, creator of "Corpo a Corpo" and "Safe Sex," portrays the lives of these health club girls who live gracefully, shrewdly, and resolutely!

191284.description:
In the era where one million people pass away in hospital rooms every year, there was a doctor who also ran a travel agency to grant the final wishes of terminally ill patients with only a short time left to live.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

191285.description: A deadly virus known as "Algernon" has attacked humanity with vicious meaning. At the forefront of the battle is the mystifying Akamatsu Industries—disguised as a heavy machine factory in Tokyo, this undercover organization uses neural enhanced weapons known as NeuroNoids to battle Algernon. Also helping with their secret efforts is the mysterious mutant who is only known as "Betterman."

191289.description:
Noah agrees to live in his dream Japanese house for a month on the condition that he communicates with the homeowner, who is a hikikomori (recluse). Noah wonders what kind of person he is, but what appears before him is Kei, a taciturn and expressionless young man who is like a cat who is not used to people. Noah had hoped to get by with minimal interaction, but he finds himself unable to leave Kei alone, as he is in such a dangerous situation that he can't believe he's been living alone. Even when I went out at night, I was worried about Kei... When Noah came home late at night and checked on Kei, he heard a seductive voice...!?

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

Note: Includes an extra chapter.

191290.description:
A fairytale about a mysterious noble lesbian who lives in a snow-blanketed manor and a poor farmer’s daughter.

"No one ever wanted to make the journey. And so, the role fell to me to go and visit the manor located deep in the mountains. I was to deliver carrots, of all things, to this residence that everyone was reluctant to visit. And there, a mysterious, beautiful, and wise individual, who called the snowy manor their home, awaited me."

191296.description:
Takeo, a fine young man, was live-streaming in a slightly naughty cross-dressing outfit. He planned to reel in a bunch of older men who were seriously in love with him, and then devastate them with a "coming out as a man" a week later...but!? On the day of the reveal, the men's reactions were completely unexpected—and from here begins a legend of sexual fetish destruction that will engulf the entire world!!!

(Source: Square Enix, translated)

A notorious property with a hidden past is now in the hands of Dan, a sharp and talented real estate agent.
The place? A manor that once belonged to the affluent Midnight family—whose bloodline vanished over a century ago.

(Source: Square Enix, translated)
synonyms: ルルの亡霊屋敷（ヘルハウス）

191298.description:
These books tell the story of He Wu-sheng, who bears the burden of being a bastard son. He witnesses the death of his biological father Yu Jing at the hands of Shi Fei-hong, who employs the A Bi (or Avici) technique of sword fighting. Wanting to avenge his father’s death, He Wu-sheng himself studies this method of sword fighting but consequently suffers every day when the flow of his qi and blood goes into reverse. Later, He sees the ninth emissary of the Avici Hell reborn in a fire. As he begins to experience representations of greed, stupidity, foolish attachment and anger in the realm of martial arts, he comes to the profound conclusion that the Avici Hell—that last and deepest of the eight hot hells— might in fact be the world of men….

(Source: Apple Books)

191299.description: Decameron is the third volume of a series by Senno Knife inspired by stories from classic literatures. The stories in this volume are based on stories by Italian writer Giovanni Boccaccio,

191301.description:
"Marriage, marriage! Let's get married right now~!!"

While on a reporting trip in Taiwan, Rintarou picks up a black envelope he finds on the street. Suddenly, a cute ghost shows up and starts calling him her husband! And that’s not enough, she follows him back to Japan and keeps bugging him to officially marry her...

(Source: Manga Park, translated)

191302.description:
A girl is searching for her first love, known only as "Bucket-kun." Holding onto a promise they once made, she enrolls in Sora no Oka High School. Just when she thinks they’re finally reunited… there turn out to be four potential candidates!? A super rich guy, a dangerous one, a total airhead, and an elite—one of these incredibly unique boys has to be him! Will she be able to uncover who "Bucket-kun" really is?

(Source: Manga Park, translated)

Note: All chapters were split into multiple parts in the original serialization and later combined in the volume releases.

191303.description: FAUST is the fourth volume of the Classic Masterpieces Collection, a series compiling stories inspired on works of classic literature. This volume contains oneshots based on stories by Goethe, Lewis Caroll and John Cleland and a story inspired by the historical figures Jeanne D'Arc and Gilles de Rais.

191304.description:
After being ravaged by war, Tougoku is now consumed by the endemic threat of UDL, a powerful and heavily addicting drug. Ibuki, a survivor living in the dregs of Tougoku’s society, sells UDL in order to fund the search for his lost mother. But then, he meets a mysterious girl named Milfie, who soon turns his search efforts upside down.

(Source: Manga UP!)

191305.description:
To protect her brother, Hari enters the royal palace disguised as a eunuch. Despite her worries, life as a male court attendant turns out to be surprisingly peaceful. At least, until she is suddenly assigned to serve Prince Sohyeon, Lee Ryeong, known for his striking beauty and well known attraction to men, in his private chambers.

“From now on, you will attend to the prince at night.”

That very evening, Hari is ordered to help arouse the prince, a task she has no way of fulfilling. Her panic spirals, and in the chaos, her greatest fear comes true, her true identity as a woman is exposed.

“You, you are a girl.”

Now discovered in the most dangerous place possible, Hari must find a way to survive the palace, its secrets, and the gaze of the prince who holds her life in his hands.

(Source: Lezhin US)

191306.description:
Rainbow Pansy, set in the countryside, is an original manga created by Umaika.

Triggered by the death of her father, Inui returns to her hometown from Tokyo and resolves to work hard as the breadwinner of the family, but...

(Source: NIUHI, edited)

Note: Released at COMITIA 146.

191309.description:
Matt, a company employee in his 30s, was getting tired of the boredom of his lie. On his way from work, he finds Tessa who was all tied up in a junkyard and ends up bringing her home. Can two people full of wounds take care of each other and live happily ever after?

(Source: DAYcomics)

A black wall encloses the city, and anyone who touches it becomes a hideous monster bent on destruction. When Akaya touches the wall, it happens to him, too. Somehow, he is able to retain enough of himself to protect humanity from the monsters. But is he alone enough to defend humanity from the hundreds of monsters who seek wanton mayhem?

(Source: Mangamo)

191316.description:
I started living alone with my crush.

Lee Tae-Eun, who started living alone as he had always wanted to due to his parents' sudden overseas assignment. However, his joy was short-lived, as he found out that his roommate was Cha Jin-Heon, and he wanted to avoid him at all costs. Jin-Heon was his long-time crush and a childhood friend who had unilaterally cut ties with him. Tae-Eun, who impulsively confessed to him while drunk three years ago but was frustrated when it didn't reach his heart at all and went into hiding, is now in a difficult situation after their unexpected reunion. He begins living together with Jin-Heon without any particular plan, but Jin-Heon is very angry at Tae-Eun and is not easy. He even set a rule of living together that they should never interact privately. And Tae-Eun, who is trying to persuade Jin-Heon in any way, faces difficult days ahead...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

191317.description:
Teased flesh giving in to secret pleasures...

191318.description:
The god of the Jeongpa and the magic of the Sapa. Two legendary doctors are getting married? Father is the god, mother is the magic. An absolute master appears before Dan Ak-Seon, who inherited his parents' medical skills. That fateful meeting leads the young Dan Ak-Seon to the world of martial arts...

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

191320.description:
When Diana le Pereshte is convinced that sacrificing her vision will restore her daughter's lost eyesight, her blindness reveals the hidden truth of her home—her "daughter" is her husband's and best friend's lovechild. Cast aside and left to question the fate of her real daughter, she succumbs to her death only to find she's woken up in the past, her vision now restored. With a second chance, can Diana find her real daughter and exact revenge, or will she find herself lost in the dark once more?

(Source: Tapas)

191322.description:
Senelia, for having the powers of a Chloracaen Thorn, is puppeted by the paranoid Emperor Clifford in exchange for her life. To thwart the plot of the original novel and avoid his fated demise, Emperor Clifford forces Senelia to usurp the original female lead as the male lead’s lover. As a plant, Senelia is to weaken him so that he cannot challenge Clifford’s throne. But Senelia falls for the man, Veneruccia, whom she’s meant to undo. Can Senelia’s love, built on a foundation of fear, survive?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: The Male Lead Is Obsessed With Proposing to Me

191327.description:
Kazuki and Towako met in their high school days and were together for 55 years. Kazuki, who cared for Towako who had dementia, was so sad that he tried to commit suicide by drowning with his wife's body. When Kazuki woke up, he was not in the afterlife but in the world of his second year of high school. Though he was confused by the time leap, Kazuki approached his classmate Towako in the hopes of being united with her again...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

The official comic adaptation of the mobile game for training young dancers! "Dankira" is a competition in which participants compete for victory through dance and killer tricks. At Kozuru Academy, the Gold students are engaged in heated Dankira matches every day. This is a story of the passionate bonds between friends and rivals, centered around Merry Panic & Etoile!

(Source: Hakusensha, translated)
