191332.description:
It’s a simple, laid‑back outdoor exhibitionism manga about a young woman who decides to undress at a bus stop—only to discover that her clothes have mysteriously vanished, leaving her in a dire predicament.

(Source: DLsite, translated)

title.native: バス停で脱いだら服が無くなっていた
title.romaji: Basutei de Nuidara Fuku ga Nakunatteita

191333.description:
Some time has passed since No. 87 returned from her fully nude lifestyle.
After a long period of staying clothed, her sense of shame has started to return—just in time for a new assignment.
A mysterious resort called “Exposure Village,” catering to extreme niche fetishes, suddenly begins airing commercials on that usual late-night show of unknown origin. To uncover the truth behind the facility, she decides to go undercover and investigate.

(Source: DLsite, translated)

title.native: 謎の露出村に潜入する
title.romaji: Nazo no Roshutsu Mura ni Sennyuu suru

191334.description:
A young woman learns about a mysterious world of exhibitionism through an enigmatic late-night TV show.

Not believing it to be real, she playfully imitates the program by exposing herself in a nearby park. But then, No. 107 from the show suddenly appears. As she follows her, the young woman finds herself lost in a strange realm of exhibitionism—where, over time, she begins to *desire* being auctioned off as livestock.

(Source: DLsite, translated)

title.native: 謎の路地は露出空間だった
title.romaji: Nazo no Roji wa Roshutsu Kuukan datta

191335.description:
After spending six months living completely nude and being treated as livestock, former No. 87 returns to the human world, reclaiming her identity and rejoining everyday life.
However, less than a week into wearing clothes again, she finds herself longing to return to the nude lifestyle and the exhibitionist realm she left behind. When she tries to go back, though, she discovers that the entrance to that world has somehow been sealed off.
In order to uncover the cause and hopefully reopen the path, she begins engaging in public nudity here in the real world—fully on display for everyone to see.

(Source: DLsite, translated)

title.native: 露出空間に入れないのでこっちで脱ぐ
title.romaji: Roshutsu Kuukan ni Hairenai node Kocchi de Nugu

191336.description:
A young woman has been casually watching a mysterious late-night TV documentary every week.
One night, she sees No. 105—the previous story's protagonist—naked and on display inside a water tank, being silently observed. The sight awakens a hidden desire within her, something she hadn’t fully acknowledged until now.
Moments later, while bathing, a strange teleportation orb appears and suddenly whisks her away—naked—into a tank of her own. From that point on, she gradually begins to *wish* for a life as livestock, embracing the idea of living completely nude under constant observation.

(Source: DLsite, translated)

title.native: 露出空間と謎の水槽は繋がっている
title.romaji: Roshutsu Kuukan to Nazo no Suisou wa Tsunagatte iru

191337.description:
A young woman purchases a “mysterious orb that transports you to an exhibitionist realm” through an online shop.
Curious but skeptical, she strips naked and decides to give the orb a try. As she experiments with it, she finds herself exposing herself in one strange location after another.
Before she realizes it, she’s living a fully nude life in an exhibitionist world far beyond Earth.

(Source: DLsite, translated)

title.native: 謎のボールに飛ばされて露出空間に
title.romaji: Nazo no Ball ni Tobasarete Roshutsu Kuukan ni

191338.description:
At first glance, it seems like the usual exhibitionist realm (another world), but it soon becomes clear that she's the only one there staying nude for the purpose of exhibitionist "sightseeing."
With no option but to remain completely naked in order to eventually return to her own world, she sets out—utterly bare—to reach a city that might hold the key to her way back.

(Source: DLsite, translated)

title.native: 露出空間じゃない所にきた
title.romaji: Roshutsu Kuukan ja Nai Tokoro ni Kita

191339.description:
As usual, senior member No. 87 is in the middle of a milking session when she suddenly remembers that the deadline to pay her apartment rent is approaching. At the same time, the newcomer, No. 98, realizes she forgot to pay her gas bill.
The two decide to urgently return to Earth.
However, due to a malfunction, they end up transported to a place that only *resembles* Earth—and worse, they land in completely separate locations.
Now, the newcomer must make her way toward where her senior was dropped, hoping to reunite with her in this strange, almost-Earth-like world.

(Source: DLsite, translated)

title.native: まちがえて別の露出空間に
title.romaji: Machigaete Betsu no Roshutsu Kuukan ni

191340.description:
A young woman with a desire for exhibitionism becomes intrigued by a mysterious realm shown in a cryptic late-night TV program that airs only after regular broadcasts have ended.
Curious and eager, she voluntarily enters this strange space—a unique kind of tourist destination where visitors can experience life as livestock, living nude and surrendering their humanity.
However, what she believed to be a temporary experience turns out to be a mistake. Due to a mix-up, her “tourist” status is lost, and she ends up being treated as a real, permanent piece of livestock… with no return date in sight.

(Source: DLsite, translated)

title.native: 新人さんが謎の露出空間に
title.romaji: Shinjin-san ga Nazo no Roshutsu Kuukan ni

1. Gendai Mahoutsukai no Okiniiri (現代魔法使いのお気に入り)
2. Tonari no Yukionna-chan (となりの雪女ちゃん)
3. Touzoku to Houseki Shoujo (盗賊と宝石少女)
4. Ryoushu-sama to Houseki Shoujo (領主様と宝石少女)

戦乙女といくさごと! 〜戦乙女編〜

191344.description:
Bodyguard Matthew, who is raising his daughter Rachel alone after divorcing his husband. Unable to resist his daughter's urge, he goes to work at a cruise party where famous painter Eden appears. Matthew is drawn to Eden's active skinship, who resembles his first love but is more muscular and shiny, and ends up spending a night with him. Their meeting, which he thought would end lightly, continues on land. Meanwhile, Eden discovers traces of his dead sister in Matthew and tries to keep Matthew by his side and watch over him...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

191346.description:
Sahara, a perpetual benchwarmer on the baseball team, was contemplating quitting as he'd lost sight of why he continued playing. That's when he spotted Ando, his childhood friend and the team's female manager, by the riverbank. Under the scorching summer sky, their fleeting youth begins to stir once more!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: 猟奇の檻: 零式百貨店物語
title.romaji: Ryouki no Ori: Reishiki Hyakkaten Monogatari

191349.description:
About 1,000 years ago, an epidemic caused all humans to turn into vampires. In-young, who was born as a mutant human in this world, is bullied because her blood smells good, and ends up going to a prestigious high school with well-raised children. Seeing her cool friends, popular model student Da-On and model Eun-Woo, In-Young looks forward to her future school life. However, soon, children who are fascinated by the scent of blood seeping from In-Young's wounds begin to surround her... At that time, a male student named Si-Hoo breaks the mood by saying, "It smells bad," and plops down next to In-Young. The survival story of In-Young, an ordinary but special human, and a heart-pounding reverse harem romance!

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

synonyms: The Perfect Slut I Solicited Was My Girlfriend's 36 y/o Mom?!

title.native: 僕の出会った理想の痴女は彼女母親 (36)でした

191351.description: The story of Guan Yunchun, the greatest warrior of the Three Kingdoms, a righteous man full of wisdom and courage, respected by even his enemies, is told in manga form! Features his greatest exploits in episodes such as The Battle of Guandu, The Thousand-Mile Journey, The Battle of the Red Cliffs, and more.

191353.description:
Saintess Serylta is tasked by God to marry the crown prince and continue the holy bloodline within the empire. Just before her wedding, a mysterious client hires two incubi to sabotage her divine mission. But Serylta is hardly a pure worker of God in the bedroom, as she quickly dominates them both with her “holy powers,” turning them into her submissive pets. And obeying their new master, the incubi reveal the perverted truth behind the scumbag who hired them...!

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: The Incubus, the Saint and the Trash

title.english: The Incubus, the Saintess, and the Scumbag

191355.description:
The first thing popular swimming star Claude says when he finally meets his idol, Olympic archery champion Nari, is "Will you marry me?" Ever since watching her compete on TV four years ago, Claude has been her biggest fan. He even earned a spot on the national swimming team just to get the chance to meet her someday. But his dramatic proposal quickly becomes the talk of the training center. As the awkward incident brings them closer, Claude’s admiration begins to grow into something much deeper.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Part of Kingdom Company's Sarangi Kkotpineun Seonsuchon (사랑이 꽃피는 선수촌) Collection.
synonyms: [Athletes' Village Where Love Blossoms] Proposal Scandal

title.english: Love is a Sport: Proposal Scandal

191356.description:
Sun-Woo is an Olympic gold medalist and Korea’s pride in air shooting. He has everything under control until fencing rookie Seong-Han asks for a handshake to “borrow his winning energy.” After that, Seong-Han takes gold, and Sun-Woo crashes spectacularly. Convinced his energy was stolen, Sun-Woo confronts him, and Seong-Han claims there is only one way to return it. What begins as a heated rivalry between two athletes quickly turns into something far more dangerous. In the Olympic Village, competition is not the only thing raising the tension.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Part of Kingdom Company's Sarangi Kkotpineun Seonsuchon (사랑이 꽃피는 선수촌) Collection.
synonyms: [Athletes' Village Where Love Blossoms] Gold Hunter, a Sure-to-Win Athlete

title.english: Love is a Sport: Victory, Gold Hunters!

191357.description:
Judo star Joo-Young and Taekwondo star Do-Yoon have been rivals and best friends since childhood. Now, they stand on the world’s biggest stage at the Olympic Games. After clinching her gold medal, Joo-Young decides it’s time to bury her long-held unrequited love for Do-Yoon once and for all. Using a childhood bet as her excuse, she asks him for a single night together to create one final memory. She expected a polite rejection or a simple favor, but Do-Yoon’s intense reaction suggests he has been waiting for this moment even longer than she has.

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note:
- Part of Kingdom Company's Sarangi Kkotpineun Seonsuchon (사랑이 꽃피는 선수촌) Collection.
- includes three extra chapters.
synonyms: [Athletes' Village Where Love Blossoms] Gold Metal Bet

191359.description:
“Forget the haunting. From now on, your only job is to make me climax. Got it?”

Exhausted by endless overtime, Yeon-Hee’s love life is non-existent. Was picking up that discarded mattress on her way home drunk a mistake? Because ever since that night, a mysterious virgin ghost has been crawling into her bed, pinning her down. But behind his chilling aura lies a touch that’s unexpectedly searing. As his inexperienced yet persistent hands find her most sensitive spots, Yeon-Hee feels herself melting into a pleasure she’s never known before. Her initial terror soon shifts into a wicked anticipation. She decides it’s time to properly train this ‘useful’ spirit….

(Source: Manta)
synonyms: 金縛りの夜だけ執着して！

191360.description:
Famous actor Kim Si-Woo is on the verge of being kicked out of the entertainment industry after being framed for drug charges against the third generation of a conglomerate.The problematic "third generation chaebol" Jo Eun-Hyun comes to help Si-Woo...

"If you hug me every day, I'll let you return to the entertainment industry."

Si-Woo, a prickly but affectionate black panther, and Eun-Hyun, a somewhat sloppy third generation chaebol rabbit, will the two be able to resolve their misunderstandings about each other...?

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)
synonyms: This Is the Rabbit You (Didn't) Order
This Is the Rabbit You Ordered (Not)

191362.description:
Inukai sits right next to the prettiest girl in class, Inuta—who tends to look and act like a dog! From cutely greeting her classmates to adorably eating lunch, Inuta exudes endless charm. Of course, Inukai is ready to lend a hand to Inuta as they spend their school lives together. Meanwhile, Saruta sits next to the most popular boy in class, catlike Nekoyanagi. Can Saruta get the better of the furred classmates who always seem to beat him? There's no telling what'll happen next when high school's gone to the dogs!

(Source: Square Enix)

191363.description:
Yoo Hae-Young was a child star with a bright future, but now, at 29, he just drifts through life. However, everything changes when the famous actor Jung Yeo-Woon asks Hae-Young to be his manager and even suggests that they live together! Though Hae-Young has spent his life avoiding the spotlight due to his past successes, he accepts the job and things seem to go well until he catches Yeo-Woon touching himself. Now, Hae-Young can't get Yeo-Woon off his mind, and it doesn't help that they're together all day and night long.

(Source: Lezhin US)
synonyms: Near and Dear：ニアー・アンド・ディアー

191364.description:
Hebigami is a new transfer student with a strange condition: whenever he gets cold, he turns into a snake! He’s feared by nearly all his classmates for his mysterious aura, but his seatmate Haruna knows his true kind nature. Since he can’t return to his human form until his body temperature is high enough, Haruna takes it upon herself to warm him up! A slow-burn, heartwarming, and youthful romcom about a nonhuman boy and an ordinary high school girl.

(Source: Manga UP!)

With his adorable face and reliability, Maki leaves Ayame blushing non-stop. An office romance between polar opposites: the baby-faced boss and the mature-looking fresh graduate!

(Source: Manga UP!)

"Will you be with me, Cinderella?"

Sari is invited to her ex's wedding, where she unexpectedly finds a second chance at love…

(Source: Renta!)

191371.description:
Exorcism is a messy business... In a world overrun by spirits, an exorcist must know how to handle himself. ♡

Loner exorcist Okuru Yotsuya has plenty of practice in that department. And while "tears" are essential to his profession, Okuru can only produce so many on his own...

When faced with an especially powerful spirit, Okuru is rescued by Naito Fukase, a pornstar known as "The Squirting Squire." Having witnessed this handsome stranger's splashy supernatural abilities up close, Okuru recruits Naito to teach him the secret to squirting...! And if Naito has anything to say about it, the exorcism business is about to get a whole lot messier...

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

191372.description:
Akira Ichinose is as flawless as ever today.

As the No.1 host at Club de Rois, Mr. Ichinose maintains a positively princely level of excellence! However, with unreliable colleagues and overbearing higher-ups to deal with, lately he's been running himself ragged... He's got all the charm he needs to keep his "princesses" happy, but what he could really use is an assistant.

Enter, Tsukasa. New to the scene at Club de Rois, Tsukasa has already managed to lose track of his princess's tab. But instead of firing him, Mr. Ichinose enlists Tsukasa to become his assistant...!

...On the condition that Tsukasa can prove his abilities go beyond just lip service, of course.

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

191375.description:
In the aftermath of a tragedy, Takumi Machi is left to raise two-year-old Kokoa by himself. While struggling to make ends meet and staggering through the unfamiliar landscape of parenting, Machi collapses in the street... Only to be rescued by an old schoolmate, Ikuto Mihiro. The good-natured Mihiro offers to house Machi and Kokoa until they get back on their feet, but Machi is skeptical of his motives. What sort of person would go to such lengths without expecting something in return...?

In spite of his doubts, with Mihiro by his side, Machi works to build a life for himself and Kokoa, untangling past trauma and learning what it really means to be family...

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

title.native: 愛はふたりのあいだから
title.romaji: Ai wa Futari no Aida kara

191376.description:
Joon-Hyuk’s only happiness in life is good food. So when, one day, he loses all taste he begins to wonder just what he has to do to fix things. When his sleazy colleague, Yoon Ji-Hoon slides over one day and tells him he knows what’s going on, Joon-Hyuk finds himself following blindly.

(Source: Lezhin US)

191377.description:
Park Yoonjung was just nearing the end of adolescence when she was suddenly dragged into a mysterious place.

(Source: Naver, translated)

191378.description:
After being thrown out into the streets at age 18, orphan Larin takes shelter at Saltator Manor and poses as a distant relative. Soon, she finds herself whisked away to the imperial palace, substituting for her adoptive sister as the emperor's new concubine. But Larin's noble disguise is not enough to hide her street rat past, and the imperial family threatens to have her killed for deceit. With the emperor vowing to protect Larin through marriage, can the pair overcome their doomed fate?

(Source: Tapas)

"I hope I can see you again."
The love I wished for on a starry night was granted in a twisted way. I'm a human, and you're a human eater. How can we weave love in such a cruel world?

(Source: GANMA!, translated)

Traditional Rural Custom Copulation for Procreation!!

For 10 days, a married woman and a young boy become a "couple" and have sexual intercourse with the genuine purpose of conceiving a child!!

In Village R, in City T, in Province N, there existed an ancient custom...

"Any woman who has already passed the age of thirty and still has no children, or who, despite wishing to have a second or third child, is unable to conceive, must be purified through the 'seed' of a young boy who is still chaste and virtuous."

191382.description:
Six grew up abused in the circus since childhood. Marlon is the underboss of the Cage Family that rules Portland and treats Six like a human being for the first time. The story of a boy who does not forget his pure heart and warm affection even in an underprivileged environment and a man who has everything but has never enjoyed a peaceful life. "I like you, Marlon. I mean it. I really love you. I'm sorry. I'm sorry for falling in love with you..."

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Chapter count includes one side story.

191383.description:
Alphas belong with omegas. Everyone knows that. Songs, poems, and fairy tales all say the same: only love between an alpha and omega is natural. Love between an alpha and a beta? Unthinkable. But Geon-Woo can’t seem to help himself. Is Geon-Woo too alpha for love...or just too stubborn to give up?

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

191385.description:
No one was prepared when the massive towers known as dungeons appeared, crawling with monsters and threatening calamity for the entire world. After she receives extraordinary culinary powers, the quiet and humble Ji-Eun is compelled to join some of the most skilled monster hunters in the world, seeing things and going places she never dreamt of before! Now, she’s making friends, having exciting adventures, and cooking up some of the tastiest dishes the dungeon has to offer!

(Source: Tapas)

191386.description:
Kim Yoon, who was at the height of her success as the top makeup artist, died from overwork. She was given a second chance to enter the world of her favorite novel La Vie en Rose, however, her luck took a turn for the worse as she ended up inhabiting the body of Calypso Partuan, the cruel stepmother who tormented Coral in the original story. Kim Yoon tries to regain her senses and live well with Coral, but she receives a letter proposing a marriage contract from the second prince of the empire, Macaron. Not only did she never agree to such a contract, and to make matters worse, Macaron was the father of the male lead, Kai! Coral was supposed to marry Kai, but now she was going to marry Kai's father?! This is a family project between people who are not related by blood at all!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: The Female Lead's Mother and the Male Lead's Father Are Married
ヒロインの継母と男主人公の父親が結婚しました

191387.description:
Ochiai Hiromitsu is the only baseball player to have won the Triple Crown three times. After retiring as a player, he led the Chunichi Dragons to four league championships and one Japan Series championship as the manager. What happens when a baseball legend is transported to another world?

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

title.native: 落合博満のオレ流転生

191388.description:
Daniela is the top player in the VRMMO game “Good cops or Badassss.” She plays a Gunslinger in game, but in real life she is Misako Tani, an ordinary office lady. When she is reborn as her own character in the game world, it's time for some flashy gunplay action! The outlaw life of a reincarnated office lady!

(Source: Comic Meteor, translated)

Drawn by the artist of the manga adaptation, a doujin imagining Atri and Natsuki after the anime's final episode!!

This is a story about raccoons, foxes, and bears causing a commotion in Tanukikoji, Hokkaido.

(Source: NIUHI)

191392.description:

191393.description:
In a world filled with monsters and magic, a cat and a hunter named Hawk begin their adventure with different purposes but with the same goal in mind: to protect something precious and seek revenge.

(Source: WEBTOON)

191394.description:
Min-Woo, who has a complex about not having any muscles on his body, enrolls in a men-only gym. Min-Woo, who believes that if he follows the gym's "special program," he will build muscles like the trainers. He tries to get used to developing his butthole...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

191395.description:
She has a childhood friend, Do Ryun-Nim, who habitually proposed to her when she was young… It is true that she liked the kind, pitiful, and intelligent Do Ryun-Nim, but Hazel, as an adult, had long since figured out the main point. Do Ryun-Nim is the youngest son of a duke’s family, and I am the young lady of a baron’s family in name only. So there will be no marriage in this life. I will live my life with the sole goal of admiring the physical beauty of men in public places (fighting arenas) and touching the chest of the royal family man. I returned home with that promise. “So, it’s not like this, Do Ryun-Nim… Huh?” As if to drive home the fact that you are no longer my ideal type, the moment she lightly touched Do Ryun-Nim’s weak chest.

“…Why is it like this?”

“Heez, I’m sorry. Are you mad? Do you want to touch my chest?”

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.
synonyms: The Young Master Hides His Chest

191396.description:
"Mister... It's me, mister..."

Jae-Hyuk, the police officer in charge of her parents' hit-and-run accident, came to see 10-year-old Eugene, and 15 years have passed since Jin began to rely on Jae-Hyuk. Eugene often shows excessive affection to Jae-Hyuk as his heart grows, but Jae-Hyuk feels uncomfortable because he thinks that he shouldn't be like that. One day, when he opens the front door to the sound of a knock, a drunk Eugene suddenly attacks Jae-Hyuk...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

191397.description:
After being framed for bullying his bully, Seon-U is forced to transfer to a new school. All he wants there is a peaceful life, but that flies out the window when he meets Sion, who seems friendly on the outside but has a few glaring red flags. Despite Seon-U's efforts to avoid him, Sion becomes his friend with an odd persistence and is obsessive, touchy-feely, and manipulative. Even so, Seon-U wants to trust the only person who seems to see his true self... but can he really let his guard down around him?

(Source: Tappytoon)

191398.description:
A strange old lady appears to the 31-year-old protagonist who graduated from a local university and has no connections or qualifications! "Buy me one..." The old lady suddenly offers him a piece of gum. She says that if you chew it, you will become smarter, better at work, and even more likable. The protagonist accidentally buys it and ends up swallowing the gum during an interview, and strangely, things start going well for him from then on...

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: A New Employee Who Works So Well?

title.native: 爆風三国志 我王の乱

191400.description:
Kagura is a samurai girl known as the "Sword Saint" for her mastery of the way of the sword. And Raito is a boy who belongs to a race called "Hito-youkai" that is hated by the people. The two met in their childhood and spent happy times together as best friends. Until the difference in their races separated them. Kagura took up the sword for Raito. To "live together" in order to do so, the bond between the two that transcends years transcends walls, races, and reality!! A one-shot story in the Sunday magazine received such a great response that it has been decided to serialize it! A Japanese-Western mixed fantasy with overwhelming brushwork that will rush out into the world! The start of this story!!

(Source: Sunday Webry, translated)

191401.description:
Is death really the end if memories live on?

Like most girls, Lala loves music, her friends and her family. However, Lala is not like most girls. Lala is a "collector" from the Memory Clan, a mysterious group of enchanted beings who have one purpose in life—they visit humans who have recently died or are on the verge of death to collect and preserve their memories.

Unique lives create unique endings. No two are the same. The Memory Clan's purpose is to keep each person's stories alive. However, the clan also has a simple rule: "Do not get involved in human affairs." For Lala, this isn't easy since she is easily entranced by humans and their stories. But in the process, she risks losing everything and everyone she loves.

Beautifully told and illustrated by talented author and artist Sui Kohno, Lala The Memory Collector weaves a poignant tale of life, death, and one girl's desire to understand what it means to be human.

(Source: Tuttle Publishing)

Note: Chapters 21, 22, 23, 24, 32, and 43 were split into two parts during the original release.

191407.description:
An office lady was complaining about her love life with her junior colleague over some drinks, before ending up in a one-night stand with her. An all-ages adult yuri romance.

(Source: Melonbooks, translated)

191408.description:
Modern science has resurrected 16 of the greatest warriors in history to determine who is the strongest! Is it the martial-god Guan Yunchang, or Xiang Yu, the warrior-king of the Western Chu? The one-man-army Lv Fengxian, or Manchu's top champion Ao Bai? One-on-one battles to the death, until there is only one winner, who will receive one wish!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

191409.description:
Koyomi's parents passed away, his job is draining, and he's endured a life full of hardship. He lives his days apathetically, with no hope for a brighter tomorrow. One day, his friends invite him to visit a shrine known for matchmaking. He prays for a life where there's someone he can come home to, with whom he can happily eat together. When Koyomi returns home that night, mundane wish still on his mind, he receives an unexpected visitor: a fox who can make his wishes come true! And so begins the loving and happy cohabitation story between a corporate slave and a gorgeous, adorable fox ♪

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

A boy who was kidnapped by a Tengu and taken to a fairyland. He speaks of an unbelievable world, and those who aspire to it will strive to reach the pinnacle of martial arts. A great fantasy tale from Kazuhiro Fujita!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

191416.description:
After her father's treason led to the downfall of her family, Evelyn Ophrose lived in hiding until her childhood friend, Ian Callician, rescued her. While at first she's relieved, Evelyn slowly realizes Ian isn't the sweet boy she once knew, and is now trapped in his cradle of seduction and lies.

(Source: Manta)

191417.description:
Working as a servant for the handsome Duke, Theodore Winston, was dreamy enough, but Alois is determined to win his heart. He has tried every trick in the book to seduce his master, only to be met with a fatherly pat on the head. When rumors of a new Duchess threaten his dreams, Alois makes a desperate plea to the heavens. The magic works a little too well by bringing a youthful and ruthless version of the Duke across time and into his arms. Now that the tables have turned, will Alois finally get the love he has been craving?

(Source: Tappytoon)

191418.description:
The magic tree that grows in Tate's hometown always existed as a safeguard from evil entities and creatures. That is, until Tate came across a runaway slave and began nursing him back to health. Suddenly, this strange man's presence causes a chain of even stranger events to occur, including an attack on the town's magic tree!

(Source: Tapas)

191419.description: Leo Zeal, in order to become an adventurer, arrives in Innsbruck, a town established around the great labyrinth where the Demon King resides. After losing consciousness after being caught up in the collapse of the Demon King's statue, Leo remembers that he is the reincarnation of Hirase Yoshito, a Japanese man who died in an unexpected accident. Determined to succeed as an adventurer so as not to repeat the misery of his past life, Leo spends the day actively and goes to sleep looking forward to tomorrow. However, when Leo wakes up, he has been transported to the moment when the Demon King's statue collapses again. All the events that occur from then on are the same as "what he experienced yesterday," and Leo realizes that the day is in a loop...! What will Leo's fate be? "Do XXX with a girl to escape the loop" A slightly erotic time loop otherworldly fantasy begins!!
synonyms: Isekai Harem Loop: I'll Embrace You Over and Over to Escape from This Repeating Day

191420.description: Bee used to be a mercenary of such high skill, she had the nickname 'Lucky Black Bee'. But now she works as a humble part-timer longing for "peaceful days", and she can't keep any job for long due to her naturally rude personality. One day, a young girl— the daughter of a female ex-colleague Bee was fond of—shows up and enlists her services as a bodyguard...

ぐるぐる目の渦原さん

191427.description:
Image consultant Jess Han, a troublemaker in Hollywood who specializes in saving irredeemable losers. Jess, who has lived his 30 years with nothing but pride, passion, and competitive spirit, has a new request from the hotel industry king Luke Leonard, who is suffering from scandal. It was okay that he decided to take on his work at the request of his close friend Alan. This man is surprisingly a formidable opponent. Jess, who has lived his whole life with his wits, is also dragged around by Luke, who has a dirty personality, unlike his known image. As he runs, flies, hangs upside down, gets a nosebleed, and eventually falls from the second floor while dreaming of revenge, Luke and he fight like a war every day, but at some point, a strange atmosphere begins to flow, and when he comes to his senses, they are kissing, and when he comes to his senses, (Luke) is saying that they are dating...

For a moment, he is shocked by the love affair that began without him knowing, but he suddenly enters full-blown love mode, but at that moment, the whole story of the tragedy that happened to the Leonard family is revealed...

191430.description:
Cafe Florence's owner, Yu Ji-An, has someone who is more like an older brother to him than his own brother. He is Choi Jae-Geon, the successor of Hwaseong Construction, who is always anxious about not being able to catch Ji-An. One day, Ji-An, who has lost her place due to some incident, is the first to reach out to Jae-Gun. "Let's go to Oppa's house." That's how their cohabitation began. The two who were always bickering and growling at each other's faces started to have a strange atmosphere between them. "Let's go to Oppa's room." Ji-An's heart flutters at Jae-Gun's one word.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

191431.description:
Classmates, seniors, and even professors! One day, Jeong-Jo starts to receive aggressive advances from men. Seeing Soo-Ho's attitude toward Jeong-Jo that doesn't change even in situations that seem to be under a curse, Jeong-Jo begins to believe that the key to solving her situation lies in Soo-Ho. However, Soo-Ho misunderstands Jeong-Jo as his stalker...

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

191432.description:
Summer is the worst for Ji-Won Choi. Ji-Won's already sensitive thighs can't stand mosquitoes or the water in the swimming pool that he went to because of his son Ha-Jun's urge, and they make him erect. And the presence of his stepbrother Lee Sang-Yoon, who comes every time, makes Ji-Won even more confused.

"I'm helping you because you're worried about your brother being uncomfortable. We're family."

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

191434.description:
In the 90s, Leo Lowell was a test subject at a research institute that conducted unethical experiments on people. The experiments were painful, but he was able to endure them because of his friends and a doctor he liked, but he eventually became a discarded test subject by order from his superiors. Feeling betrayed by the doctor he trusted the most, Leo began hunting everyone in the research institute in order to get revenge...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

191435.description:
Top tier gangster! Top tier Alpha! Baek Pil-Seung. A foolish gangster who can't resist anything cute?! He fell for the prickly Maltese Nam Woo-Yoon, who is clueless about the ways of the world. Woo-Yoon, an Omega without a proper registration, learns that his only brother has died and goes to find him, but his life takes a drastic turn when he meets the gangster Baek Pil-Seung.

“I’ve never seen anyone who looks like you before. You’re stuck in my head and it’s driving me crazy, what the fuck do I do?”
“......”
"Fucking hell. Fuck me. I'm such a pushover."
“......”
“I'll protect you. I’ll find your brother.”
“......”
“Let’s date.”

Can the pushover gangster Pil-Seung win over the prickly Woo-Yoon, who’s as difficult as a Maltese?

Awkwardly dragging the people around her into the chaos, and sometimes making use of her powers along the way, she sets out to reclaim the youth she left unfinished.

191480.description:
This is a collection of works created by Otomo Katsuhiro between 1980 and 1981, when he was 26-27 years old. The collection includes the title work, which had its six chapters published in the quarterly magazine “Manga Kisotengai” published by Kisotengaisha, as well as four short manga, one short manga, and a series of short stories consisting of 12 stories. “APPLE PARADISE,” a scifi mystery story set on a huge resource-mining spaceship that is about to return to Earth from a distant planet. Similar to the previous volume, "G.....", APPLE PARADISE had never been published in a collected format; but now, at last, all six installments (about 120 pages, unfinished) are included. The collection also includes the Western masterpiece “St. Berg's Hill no Omoide” and the complete “That's Amazing World,” a series of short stories based on fairy tales and literature. The short stories in the collection include two from “SOS Daitokyo Tankentai” (1996, Kodansha), one one-shot and four short stories from “Kanojo no Omoide..” (1990, Kodansha), one one-shot and eight short stories from “Hansel and Gretel” (1981, Sony Magazines), “GOOD WEATHER” (1981/Kitansha), and one short story from ‘GOOD WEATHER’ (1981/Kitansha). The short story “I・N・R・I” was changed to read from right to left when it was first published in a tankobon, but in this volume, it is read from the end of the book from left to right as in the original manuscript, and is reprinted in two-color as it was first published in the magazine. In addition, the short story “ELECTRIC BIRD LAND,” which appeared in black and white when first collected, is reproduced for the first time in its original two-color version as it appeared in the magazine.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

191482.description:
In childhood, Woo-Yeon, who developed from a beta to a zealous omega, ran away with his mother to avoid his father who was sure to sell him out because of gambling debts. After that, he received a scholarship to pay for his mother’s hospital bills and worked part-time every day. Then, he happened to come across Jeong-Han, the son of the owner of the mansion where his mother used to work, at a school opening ceremony. Jeong-Han pretends to know him and drinks with him, and even buys him meals to do group projects together.

“Are you always that interested in other people?”
“Have you forgotten? I told you I was interested in my senior.”

He tried to push him away, thinking it was a joke, but eventually received help from Jeong-Han.

“Jeong-Han, thank you for today. I won’t forget you for the rest of my life. I’ll repay you no matter what.”
“Anything? Then sleep with me like this once in a while.”
“…What?”

Will Woo-Yeon ever be able to escape the dangerous yet affectionate Jeong-Han?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

191483.description:
Oh Seong-Hwan, the owner of a bakery called 'Ppang Ppang Village' in a small provincial town. Since he was young, he has been linked up and down with all the gays in the neighborhood in search of true love, but has yet to meet someone he likes. Then one day, Seong-Hwan is insulted by his boyfriend and they break up. The scene is caught by Kim Ji-Woo, a part-time worker and disciple of the bakery. Ji-Woo immediately starts to confront Seong-Hwan, who is flustered, asking how he is?!

"I can do better...! Please date me!"

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

191485.description:
Brilliant in both looks and talent, Ryu Chan-Yeong is an elite violinist admired by everyone around him. For Joo Ha-Jin, he is not just a role model but the person he dreams of standing beside on stage one day. That dream feels painfully distant until Ha-Jin is suddenly given a rare chance to receive private mentoring from Chan-Yeong himself. But fate takes a strange turn when Ha-Jin accidentally overhears something he was never meant to hear. Before he can even process it, Chan-Yeong confronts him with a shocking proposal. For a limited time, they will become intimate partners, and when Chan-Yeong decides it is over, it will end cleanly. In exchange, Ha-Jin will receive the mentorship he has longed for.

Caught between ambition, desire, and the dangerous pull of the man he admires, Ha-Jin must decide how much he is willing to risk for his dream.

(Source: Lezhin US)

191487.description:
Lionel, raised in a violent and suffocating home, finds his first real affection when he meets Arthur, an immortal merman living in human form within an old castle. But Lionel’s family is obsessed with a legend that promises eternal life through the body of a merman, and they set their sights on Arthur. Torn between love and the chains of his family, Lionel must decide whom he will protect.

(Source: Lezhin US)

191489.description:
In the early 1960s, a major transformation of food culture took place in South Korea. After the war, starvation became a daily occurrence for the people, who had to make do with a bowl of honey-porridge made by picking out leftovers from US military bases. Jeon Joong-Yoon was worried about the lives of the people struggling in poverty and providing them with a proper meal. Kim Hang-pil, a new employee who finished his service as a KATUSA and got a job, thinks of his loved one and wants to join Joong-Yoon's cause. Hang-Pil's unrequited love, Lee Young-Hee, sells honey-porridge in an unlicensed shantytown, carrying the pain and sorrow of war. Loved ones and neighbors abandoned everywhere in the field of starvation. Through devotion, patience, and effort toward them, 'Ramen', a symbol of the common people's food, was born.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

Dong-Jae and his family in their mid-forties, a slightly different story they create.

During a terrorist attack, CEO Jung-Hoon is saved by a soldier named Ha-Yoon Jang. Determined to find her, he hires ex-special forces Ji-Woo as his secretary. As they clash and grow closer, a hidden truth and a corporate plot threaten everything. Can Ji-Woo protect Jung-Hoon while keeping her secret?

(Source: Manta)

191494.description:
Lyricist Choi Woo-Rim, but now an unknown who can't make money as a lyricist. Choi Woo-Rim is busy working as a company employee during the day and a lyricist at night to make a living. Then one day, Woo-Rim meets his favorite celebrity, Ki Yoo-Seong, who planted in his mind the dream of becoming a lyricist. Ki Yoo-Seong is a man... completely different from what I thought!

(Source: Naver, translated)

191495.description:
Cali is on a quest to discover her identity and must travel to see the elf queen of Sorte, who left her at the convent as a baby. After hearing Duke Lycan Warren and his knights are traveling in that direction, she disguises herself as the deadly duke’s fiancée and ends up in a political marriage. Although Cali plans to run away eventually, she finds herself being drawn to Lycan as their hearts and bodies grow closer. Can the unlikely couple forge a true bond despite their secrets and lack of experience in love?

(Source: Tappytoon)

191496.description:
Ji-An, an S-rank guide in Korea who isn't compatible with any espers, people gifted with superpowers, finds herself on a strange continent one day. There, she meets Duke Wisrode, an esper she can finally guide. However, her excitement is short-lived when she discovers that she is the only guide in this land, which is full of espers, and the duke wishes to keep her to himself. Will Ji-An be able to find her way back to her own dimension safely? Or will she be stuck here as the lone guide forever?

(Source: Tapas)

191497.description:
Eunri Dam was only a child when she found Gyeol's bloody body in the river by her home in Je. Back then, she didn't know his real name was Segyeol Yiheon or that he was the crown prince of Sayuta...Je's enemy nation. Gyeol knew that Eunri was to be engaged to the crown prince of Je, but even that couldn't stop him from falling for her. Before returning to his homeland, Gyeol promised Eunri that he would marry her one day. After that...everything went up in flames.

(Source: Tapas)

191502.description:
Reiko is a rich heiress to a zaibatsu, but she chose to work as a detective. She resents her superior, Kazamatsuri, who always seem to be making illogical deductions that causes murder cases to become cold cases. One day, her butler suddenly announces his retirement, and he chooses Kageyama as his replacement. Reiko realizes that Kageyama's deduction skills are very good after Kageyama solved a seemingly unsolvable mystery.

After that, whenever Reiko meets an unsolvable case, she would lay out the details of the case for Kageyama, and he would explain to her how that particular case is solved after dinner. After every case, Kageyama also explains to Reiko some universal truth or human nature that led to each crime being committed.

(Source: Wikipedia)

191503.description:
In ancient times, an evil dragon threatened to flood and drowned a certain village. Since then, every year, the villagers would sacrifice a bride to appease the dragon and ensure the peace and safety of the village. This year, it is the black dragon Yan Ming’s turn to enjoy the human sacrifice. However, he has no interest in human flesh and prefers a diet of fruits instead. But he was forced by his butler Xi Que to follow tradition and go to the village to receive the village's offering. Yan Ming was only going through the motions until he became intrigued by the strange, "mute" bride! She wasn’t afraid of him at all. In fact, she seems almost excited?! Whatever… let's take her home first!

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

Ten years ago, Lin Su craftily orchestrated a scheme to bring about the downfall of the Huai Prince's household, and escaped to foreign lands to avoid retribution. By a twist of fate, the young man he met there turns out to be one of the victims of his elaborate revenge. Mu Yingfeng concealed his true identity to try to find out the truth behind the treasonous plot — but he never expected that the distinguished scholar he seduced would turn out to be the architect behind his father and brothers' deaths. Caught in a delicate dance of trial and manipulation, their lives and destinies become hopelessly intertwined.

191509.description:
Gaku is the son of former Japanese national volleyball star Kei Shishiya. Through middle school, he's played as his team's ace hitter, though part of him wonders if that's a title he earned, or one he was simply given. One day, Kei meets Noboru, a generational volleyball talent with a monstrous spiking arm, and vows to turn him into the next national standout. In the wake of that choice, Gaku realizes he can't play the style his father demands, but swears he'll defeat both Kei and Noboru with a game that's entirely his own.

191511.description:
Yanai, a successful manga editor, is in Shinjuku to research the lives of youth who hang out around Kabukicho, when a girl suddenly grabs him by the shirt. Misumi lives in a manga cafe, cleans a love hotel for what little cash she has, and spends all her time devouring manga—but now she’s started writing it, and wants Yanai to take a look. He’s dismissive at first, until he finally reads it and discovers she has real, if unpolished, talent. He offers to be her editor, but gets more than he bargained for when this almost feral girl suddenly takes up residence in his apartment! Her desperation and fixation are at total odds with the professional world he knows, jolting him out of his normal routine and opening his eyes to what manga is really about.

(Source: Kodansha USA)

191514.description:
It was an overwhelmingly intense love at first sight. Rings, chokers, black nails, countless piercings in his ears... Akane, the wild bassist of the struggling band 666DOPES. And Toui, the guitar-vocalist who fell for him and started dating him. Toui, bewildered yet devoted to caring for Akane as he repeatedly self-harms and craves painful sex, yearned to understand his heart. But he always got sidetracked, and his words slipped out. "If you just want to make me worry, please stop." Hearing this, Akane smiled sadly. "So that's how you see me, huh?" The more they love each other, the more they hurt each other. Strumming their lonely love between Thanatos and Eros. Sex, Love & Rock 'n' Roll!

(Source: Kadokawa)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: 若妻の秘蜜　堕ちゆく美沙子の爛れた日々
title.romaji: Wakazuma no Himitsu: Ochiyuku Misako no Tadareta Hibi

title.romaji: Tsuyameki Kengi: Hihou Meguri to Mitsu-iro no Miko

191517.description:
The series is an omnibus series that "realistically" tells stories about the sexuality of women in their 30s. One of the stories follows 35-year-old Mikako Sano, a single woman who hasn't had a boyfriend in 10 years. While she isn't desperate to settle down, she soon meets a flirtatious businessman named Hashimoto, who prefers to be alone, and she becomes interested in him.

(Source: Anime News Network, edited)

title.romaji: Kore ga Saigo no XXX Kamo

191518.description:
Welcome to the Cutie Coliseum, where warriors battle it out to claim the title of the ultimate "Cutie"! Etsuko Dogenzaka embraces her Heisei-era Gyaru style to stay true to her own brand of cuteness as she aims for the crown! But fate throws her a curveball when she's matched against a tournament favorite in the very first round...?!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: キューティーコロシアム

191519.description:
A nurse wakes up after a car accident to find herself in the body of Alicia, a despised villainess princess of the Arjan Kingdom.

Banished to the Ostreve Empire as one of the emperor’s 13 concubines, she must rise from the lowest rank to become empress to survive.

Armed with modern cooking skills and medical knowledge, she’s determined to defy the odds and live through this twisted new life!

(Source: Piccoma, translated)
synonyms: How the Villainous Alicia Saves the Day

title.native: 悪女アリシアの救国レシピ

191520.description:
Known for being "the cutest girl in Japan", Yuan meets an incredibly cute transfer student! Yuan's sense of identity is crumbling...or so you might think...?

(Source: Cheese!, translated)

title.native: 私より可愛いJKがいたら〇す
title.romaji: Watashi yori Kawaii JK ga Itara 〇su

191521.description:
Meet Miyu-chan, the world's most demanding girl with separation anxiety and a need for control, and me, who just can't say no. A 39-page story about codependency from a rising star.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: でも美優ちゃんには僕がいないと
title.romaji: Demo Miyu-chan ni wa Boku ga Inai to

title.native: まじがみ　～神倉さんは噛みグセがある～
title.romaji: Majigami: Kamikura-san ha Kamiguse ga Aru

title.native: 肉欲の会議室 ――人妻秘書は他人棒に啼く――
title.romaji: Nikuyoku no Kaigishitsu: Hitozuma Hisho wa Taninbou ni Naku

191526.description:
A prosecutor fights to expose fraudsters, driven by a past wound—when their own father was conned. Inspired by his advice, they take on cunning criminals, uncovering scams and revealing how deception works. But in a world of lies, can they stay one step ahead of the masterminds?

(Source: Toomics)

title.english: Fraud Smash : Prosecutor Lim's Secret Operation

191527.description: Note: Published in Hitozuma-tachi Kakusarete Seitaiken wo Bakuro
synonyms: Mother and Son Taboo - Castaways on a Desert Island

title.native: 禁断母子無人島漂流記

191530.description:
Shunsuke Suzuki, who works at an advertising agency, spends his days being abused by his strict trainer Kojima. While thinking about quitting the company and wishing Kojima had died, Suzuki happens to see a commercial that Kojima made. The commercial shows a project that Suzuki had thought up and Kojima had rejected. Kojima had taken Suzuki's other projects as his own. When Suzuki confronts him about it, Kojima doesn't apologize, he just gets angry. Seeing Kojima come to work as if nothing had happened, Suzuki finally feels murderous. Then, as Suzuki searches the internet for ways to commit the perfect crime, a mysterious person named Yamino appears, telling him that he should get revenge in his own way...

(Source: Natalie, translated)
synonyms: Smiling Nemesis: Revenge Only You Can Take

title.native: 笑うネメシス―貴方だけの復讐―
title.romaji: Warau Nemesis: Anata Dake no Fukushuu

191531.description: Based on the 1993 SNES Action game by the same name.

191532.description:
Earth, the third planet in the solar system. Countless years have passed since humanity's birth. Great advances in science, biology, and technology were supposed to have freed mankind from strife and suffering, bringing peace and prosperity. But in the year 2030, Earth, once humanity's cradle, is on the verge of human extinction.

Survivors: 258.

Gundam: One.

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: 機動戦士ガンダムエイト

191533.description:
Yong-Joo is a surgeon and a damn good one at that. And although she's made it to the top of her field, she has another dream: to become a mom. But in a world without men and a rigorous selection process for those who apply to be mothers, Yong-Joo has a better chance at being struck by lightning than accomplishing that dream. But what if she were to take less savory means...?

(Source: Tapas)

191534.description:
Kazuki, the daughter of a wealthy businessman, and a straight-A student at a prestigious school for girls, meets Moka, a wild girl from a rowdy school. What becomes of Kazuki when witnessing a steamy moment between Moka and her boyfriend leaves her all shaken up...?! Find out in this seaside tale of two polar opposites and their fated encounter.

(Source: MANGA Plus)

191535.description:
Being popular is nothing new for Hyeok Ji-Seung. He’s always had admirers, and Tae Eon-Ho is just another one, aside from the whole being a guy thing. Ji-Seung found it Eon-Ho's terrible attempts at hiding his crush amusing…until Eon-Ho took things a step too far. Cute is one thing. Breaking into his room and hiding in his closet? That’s another story.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes three extra chapters.

191536.description:
After an embarrassing first encounter with the drunken Seungrak, freshman Doyeop is dismayed to meet him again as his senior. But Seungrak, who can’t sleep alone, proposes a limited-time deal with Doyeop, whom he finds perfectly “pillow-like.” Doyeop reluctantly agrees... but what is he getting into?

(Source: Manta)

191537.description:
Kang Rak-Won, the CEO of a planning company who started out as an idol, hears the news of the suicide of Lee Do-Woon, who used to be in the same team. Ten years ago, Team Delight was disbanded due to Do-Woon's betrayal, so Rak-Won attends the funeral with mixed feelings. Rak-Won takes a short nap at the funeral. When he wakes up, he has returned to the past 20 years ago. However, the members are already slightly out of sync.

"Everything is so easy for you, hyung."
"Do it without me. I don't want to sing."
"I don't even have that much skill... It's ridiculous. The song I wrote."

Rak-Won fights to prevent the team's disbandment and Lee Do-Woon's suicide. The story of three dogs with different owners and servants regaining their idol status.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Includes ten extra chapters.

191538.description: Note: Published in Comic Go Ranshin Vol.2

191539.description:
After another wild night of clubbing, rich brat I-Su is forced to decide between working as an intern or having all his credit cards canceled. He begrudgingly chooses to become a sales intern, but one of the team leads at his company is Jin Hyuk, the same handsome guy he had a one-night stand with! Though tries to use his sex friend, Ye-Jun, to forget about Hyuk, it unlocks a possessive and jealous side to Ye-Jun that I-Su's never seen before. With his new workload, Hyuk, and Ye-Jun to worry about, will I-Su ever catch a break?

(Source: Lezhin US)

191540.description:
A matchmaking share house produced by a women's fashion magazine. Eight men and women, without revealing their age or occupation, live together for three months to find a marriage partner. People have different reasons for gathering in the share house: they're too busy with work to keep up with finding a partner, they want to find a partner quickly, they admire their parents' lovey-dovey ways...

"You can live alone, but don't you sometimes wish you had someone by your side?"

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: ウチに帰って婚活します
title.romaji: Uchi ni Kaette Kon Katsu Shimasu

191541.description:
Dennis keeps getting dumped. He’s popular and sexy, but his girlfriends always fall for his classmate, Evan. They’re not the only ones charmed by Evans’s handsome face and thoughtful ways, though. Even Dennis is having a hard time remembering he hates Evan, and Evan seems way too flirty for a rival.

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

191542.description:
The story follows Kiri Koshiba, a talented hairstylist, who is drawn into the activities of "S.P. (Scissors Project)," a group where members showcase their hairstyling skills. Even after graduating, Kiri and her rival Narumi continue their friendly competitions, reigniting their reasons for pursuing hairstyling.

(Source: Oricon News, translated)

title.native: ビューティーポップ Returns-リターンズ-

191543.description:
Welcome to an LA Korean spa that accidentally turned into a holy ground for hot, chaotic gays! Enter Eden, a swoon-worthy CIA agent with the body of a Greek god, and Romeo, a mafia boss whose hands are as dangerous as they are... skilled. Both men lock eyes on one unsuspecting target: Su-Min, a sweet and slightly flustered Korean student working as a scrub master. Caught in a steamy love triangle full of slippery situations, shirtless standoffs, and suspiciously sensual scrubbing, Su-Min becomes the prize in a ridiculous showdown between brawn and finesse. Will Eden’s all-American muscles win him the boy? Or will Romeo’s sinful charm steal Su-Min’s heart (and maybe his towel)?

One spa. Two rivals. Three very questionable intentions. In the end... can’t they all just share the love?

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.native: エリンジウムが咲いたら

だらしない姉にヤらせたい!

191553.description:
Ji-Soo is having a headache because of his private tutor Jun-Young. Jun-Young, who has been arrogant since their first meeting, keeps pestering him.

"I'm a private tutor, and you're my student!"

But it's no use saying that. Jun-Young is confident that he will seriously target Ji-Soo after graduation. Will Jun-Young overcome the rough older man's iron wall and win his love? How long will Ji-Soo be able to withstand the direct attacks of the younger man? A realistic bickering romance between an older man and a younger man.

(Source: Ridibooks)
synonyms: Get Real: Ji-Soo and Jun-Young's Story

191555.description:
This work is a combination of two short stories, [Large Dog] (chapters 1-7) and [Get Pet] (chapters 8-9).

[Large Dog] Min-Su reunites with his neighbor, Yoon-Jin, who immigrated to the United States when he was young, after 7 years. The two, who had been in contact the whole time , promised to date when Yoon-Jin confessed his love right before returning to Korea . Min-Su waited nervously for the moment of reunion―

"......Who are you?" I don't know, who are you, I'm scared......"

The meeting between the large dog Yeon-Ha-Gong and the small dog Yeon-Sang-Su goes awry from the start. Will their relationship be okay like this?

[Get Pet] The only one who can stop Min-Woo, the crazy dog ​​of the prep school, is Min-Hyung. Min-Woo reacts fierily to other people's pranks, but for some reason, he becomes gentle in front of Min-Hyung. Min-Hyung, who feels unexpected feelings for Min-Woo, tries to distance himself from him...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

title.native: 夜から覚めて夜行性の青 after-
title.romaji: Yoru kara Samete Yakousei no Ao after

title.native: 牛ギャルなんか怖くない

191558.description:
The happiest time for Cheon, a slave, was when he took care of the young master Se-Young like a younger brother. After parting ways with Se-Young, he was bullied by his master for a long time and was destined to be offered up as a sacrifice to the general. However, the general he met before his eyes looked familiar? The grown Se-Young whispers to Cheon, who is happy to be reunited with the master.

"You are mine now, mister. Everything, even the deepest part of my body."

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

Note: Part of Peanutoon's Geosi,Girong Danpyeonseon (거시,기록 단편선) Collection.

[Macro, Record Short Story] If You Get Caught by the Dragon's Tail

191559.description:
Sakwol, who was of lowly status, was taken in by Grand Prince Sibaek, and became close to him as a servant and companion. Sakwol admired Sibaek and followed him, but one day he was suddenly abandoned. After that, a great upheaval occurred, and the world was in chaos due to ghosts, and the previous order and rules collapsed. Sakwol awakens as a strong 'guardian' and deals with ghosts, and the people follow him instead of the king. While eliminating the incompetent royal relatives, Sibaek is captured in front of Sakwol. "I make this Sibaek my slave." Sakwol's hatred shows its teeth.

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

Note: Part of Peanutoon's Geosi,Girong Danpyeonseon (거시,기록 단편선) Collection.

[Macro, Record Short Story Collection] His Majesty the Grand Prince's Master

191560.description:
Su-Hyeon has a loving boyfriend, Hae-Min, but the passion’s gone cold. Haunted by dreams of being taken rough and without restraint, Su-Hyeon can’t shake the hunger that gnaws at him. Then one night at a bar, he meets a man who embodies everything he’s been craving: sharp eyes, a dangerous smile, and a touch that leaves him trembling. As Su-Hyeon falls deeper into the affair, Hae-Min discovers the truth, and what follows is a story of love, lust, and betrayal—perfectly arranged in threes.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.native: 戦士ちゃんと触手くん
ココロ・アップデート
透けてるスライムギャル

191568.description:
Ageha, an orphan, lives with her childhood friend Hotaka and works as a hostess to make her dreams come true. One day, she gets into trouble at work and is reunited with a "certain person" she was separated from as a child... The forbidden love triangle story begins.

(Source: Flower Comics, translated)
synonyms: The Butterfly is Caught in a Cage of Love and Obsession

title.romaji: Chou wa Aishuu no Ori ni Torawareru

191570.description:
Handsome, academically excellent, and an all-around athlete -- The perfect man, Mamoru Nishiwaki, drives people crazy, but he has one huge weakness... his younger brother!

The explosive birth of a comedy about a sibling complex that will make you laugh (and cry!?)!!

(Source: Cheese!, translated)

Her family home is on the verge of bankruptcy! To ​​save herself from this predicament, Mio enters into a contract marriage with her childhood friend, who has transformed into a cold-hearted, scheming man...

(Source: Cheese!, translated)

title.romaji: Cinderella wa Amai Kiss ni Aragaenai

191581.description:
Hyeri Kang’s a screwup with a criminal record and crushing debt. After abducting a seemingly wealthy woman to pay off the loan sharks, she realizes that her victim is actually a cross-dressing man—and a serial killer fresh off his latest murder. The pair soon end up in a violent, sexual codependency that reveals a shared trauma and the grief that shattered both of their lives. Can they outrun the past and start over together? Or will karma catch them, destroying any chance of a future?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

191582.description:
It’s the intense semi-final match at the Madrid Games. The U-23 Japanese national team led by Tsubasa Ozora clashes with Spain, the favorites led by Angelic Michael, in the second half of their match. Who will emerge as the victors and advance to the championship match? Will Japan finally achieve its long-awaited gold medal? The final chapter of the series, unfolding on an unprecedented scale, will be serialized in this rough, pencils-only style! 

(Source: Captain Tsubasa WORLD)

title.native: キャプテン翼 ライジングサン FINALS

191583.description:
Tonomura, a high school student in Hokkaido, meets piano tuner Itadori by chance and aspires to become a tuner himself. After graduating from vocational school, he begins working as a tuner at the music store where Itadori works. With the help of his instructor Yanagi, Tonomura gains experience, but an encounter with a pair of talented twins changes him...

A warm and beautiful story that delicately depicts the growth of a young man who is lost and worried, but moves forward into the future.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

191585.description:
Beom Gyu-Hwa always believed he was an alpha, until one strange night turned everything upside down. Desperate to pay tuition, he accepts a high-paying gig...only to find out it’s at Sehan Hotel, a place he swore he’d avoid at all costs. Things take a turn when his body starts reacting oddly, his pheromones feel off, and worst of all, he runs into the last person he ever wanted to see... When instincts take over, Gyu-Hwa is forced to confront a truth he never saw coming. He's in heat.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes seven extra chapters.

" Today, I met a nice guy at university.“
”......What, you, too?"
"Wait? Mashiro, too?"

Even before school started, Hanamiya, Miyu, and Shinsuino Mashiro came to be known as the “three sisters of beauty.” The girls, who draw attention of everyone around them, had a stepbrother who became separated from them in the past. That's Yuto, whom they meet soon after entering university....... The three girls were just talking about Yuto as a kind person and good brother? Yuto just wants them to treat him normally, but for some reason, all three sisters are making advances on him!

"Don't tell the other two......."

The first time they reunite in over a decade, the three step-sisters all fall for him, in this harem love comedy.

(Source: GA Bunko, translated)

191597.description: Set in the early 20th century, Kokoro opens with a chance encounter on a beach near Tokyo that irrevocably links a young student to a man he simply calls Sensei (Teacher). Intrigued by Sensei's aloofness, the student calls upon him with increasing frequency. Eventually, Sensei and his beautiful wife open their home and their lives to him. Only later does the student learn the devastating secret that has haunted Sensei since his youth.

191600.description:
Yu Bom has never cared for sweet boys her age. What stirs her is the fantasy of rugged older men, those with tanned skin, rough hands, and the raw masculinity of a hard life etched into their bodies. The construction site, filled with men who embody everything she craves, becomes the perfect stage for her secret desires. But fantasies have a way of bleeding into reality, and Yu Bom is about to step into a world that blurs the line between imagination and temptation.

(Source: Lezhin US)

191601.description: An insecure college student, Mahiro Miyashita, goes through a major makeover for his university debut. Since then, he's been satisfying his need for approval through a dating app. One day, he matches with a guy named Shuu, who's handsome, interesting, clever, and even amazing in bed! However, after a thoughtless comment from Mahiro, the two clash and end up having an argument, ending with Mahiro storming out of the hotel vowing never to see Shuu again. So of course he soon finds out that not only do they go to the same university, they now have to work together in the same research lab.

191602.description: Mizoguchi is a small but masculine president of a system company. Due to a crisis, he decided to sign a "servant contract" with a client and young president of a large company, Washinomiya, in exchange for money. Despite being one year younger, Washinomiya let go of his sharp aura. Mizoguchi, who had always thought he wouldn't be able to live up to him, decided to accept this deal for his friends... In the hotel shower room, long fingers play with his body and relaxes his behind... What will happen to Mizoguchi, who is put in a humiliating situation...?!

191603.description:
Japan, early 20th century. Subaru Karasuma, an aspiring writer with dashed ambitions, neck-deep in loans he has no hope of paying back, decides it’s time to draw the curtain on his miserable life. Before he can follow through on his dark intent, he’s diverted by the spectacle of a neighbor working frenetically with his literary group to meet the deadline for a work commissioned by Geppo Yagira, a rich and famous novelist. When the devilishly handsome, fiercely talented Geppo lays his eyes on Subaru, the latter’s life is set on a new course. But the new path he’s now treading seems to lead ever deeper into the darkness...

(Source: Manga UP!)

Woo Eun-Jo is an airport employee who’s secretly sleeping with the hottest and youngest plane captain, Ki Su-Ho. Eun-Jo is convinced their friends-with-benefits arrangement won’t ever become something more, but Su-Ho’s sweet gestures make it impossible to keep his feelings from growing. It doesn’t help that Su-Ho feels anxious himself at Eun-Jo’s constant mixed signals and actually wishes their relationship could take off as well. Buckle up, as this romantic flight will be experiencing A LOT of turbulence!

In the 19th century, the golden age of medicine was ushered in by the introduction of anesthesia. An ambitious doctor named Hutson began practicing medicine at a rural hospital called Canbury at the recommendation of a professor. One day, Hutson found a patient in the forest whose entire body was burned. However, as he examined the patient, strange situations began to unfold that he could not explain with his medical knowledge.

(Source: Naver, translated)

Satoru's love life has hit rock bottom. As "The World's Worst Lover," he's been dumped time and again due to his terrible skills in bed. Just when he thinks all hope is lost, the God of Seduction, affectionately nicknamed Ecchan, suddenly appears to turn his fortunes around! Ecchan reveals that the only way to make things right is to find Satoru’s perfect partner—a match so ideal that sparks are guaranteed to fly.

Enter Shinya Hoshina, a wildly popular actor and Satoru's supposed soulmate. Satoru manages to get close to Shinya, leading to a night that redefines everything he thought he knew about pleasure. But as Shinya’s kindness and sincerity begin to melt Satoru’s heart, what started as divine intervention turns into something much deeper.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

191625.description:
A story about boys who grow from boys to adults during adolescence, and who worry, make mistakes, and gradually come to terms with the many facets of life.

Tanahashi Yusei is a popular boy who excels in both academics and sports, and naturally has people gathering around him. Yusei has a classmate he admires, but he can't tell anyone about him. That person is Nakagawa, an inconspicuous boy who his friends don't even seem to notice. The two become closer after a certain incident...

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

Notes:

191626.description:
Shizuku Futakawa is used to being abandoned. So far, he's been abandoned by his mother, his abusive father, and his stepmother. He doesn't have time to wallow, though, because he's responsible for his younger stepbrother Kikutaro. Determined to be a good big brother, Shizuku sets out to ensure a successful future for Kikutaro to the best of his ability.

One day, he returns home and mistakenly thinks that his little brother has been kidnapped by his next door neighbor, Tsujido. Seeing that the brothers are struggling on their own, tough-looking and aloof Tsujido starts helping out and cooking warm meals for them. For the first time in his life, Shizuku gets a taste of what it's like to be cared for...

(Source: TOKYOPOP)

191627.description:
After her brother gambles away the money owed for his marriage, Louise is offered as payment under the so-called Right of the First Night. The man who claims her is Richard, Lord of Evron—a ruthless war hero feared for his icy heart. Trapped in his castle, Louise must survive the night... and the man they call a monster.

(Source: Manta)

Note: Includes five extra chapters.

191629.description:
A sex partner was born overnight. And he was so damn handsome. Ji Eun-Yeon, an omega with a unique constitution who can't sense pheromones, gets dumped by his cheating lover who calls him a "fake omega." (Souce: Lezhin, translated)

191630.description:
High school student Asakura Asaki finds himself trapped in a time loop, reliving the same day again and again. Just when the repetition starts to feel unbearable, he meets Sugiyuki Kako, a mysterious girl whose strange behavior reveals that she, too, is aware of the loop. Desperate to escape, Asaki asks Kako for help, but for reasons she won’t explain, she refuses to break free. As the days repeat, Asaki tries every possible way to spark her interest and change her mind.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title.english: The Tomorrow I Want to See with Kako: A Time-Loop Romantic Comedy
title.native: 杉雪カコと見たい明日

191632.description:
In a society where only alphas and omegas matter, beta Kim Min-Jun has spent his life being overlooked. Everything changes when elite alpha Bae Yu-Ri, desperate to escape his role, asks Min-Jun to act as his stand-in. What begins as a simple business arrangement slowly turns intoxicating, as Min-Jun discovers how it feels to be the one giving orders and Yu-Ri finds himself responding like the omega he always wished he could be. In a world with such strict social hierarchies, can they resist the pull of a desire that breaks every rule?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes four extra chapters.

191633.description:
"Revenge tastes like ripe honey..."

Serena, the daughter of a viscount, becomes the wife of Heaven, the beautiful son of an earl. Although he was her childhood first love, their married life is far from happy. He belittles her as a dim-witted, plain woman and treats her with disdain, only engaging in babymaking at his whims out of obligation, all while openly cheating on her. Determined to take revenge, Serena devises a plan to shatter Heaven's pride so completely that he wouldn't dare reveal it to anyone. Serena, who's caught between hatred and love, and Heaven, the pinnacle of scum. Where will their love-hate relationship take them?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

191634.description:
Having lost both her parents in a fire at the age of fifteen, Sae was adopted by her uncle and treated like a slave. When a marriage proposal arrives for her younger sister, Chiyo, Sae is forced to take her place. The reason for this substitution is that the prospective fiance is a beastman, a race rumored to devour humans. However, upon meeting her future husband, the white wolf Souhaku, Sae finds him quite different from the man-eating beast she had anticipated...

(Source: Pocket Comics)

191635.description:
The eldest daughter of House Northmoont, Helse, shoulders the responsibility of her family as the stand-in lady while her father is bedridden. However, she faces increasing pressure from rival families vying for Northmoont's power. One day, Helse decides to offer herself as a hostage to the Kartago, known as the brawny descendants of wolves. There, she discovers that the wolves have strong desires and practice sharing unmarried women among their men! Between the wolf monarch and a virgin noblewoman unfolds a captivating romantic fantasy, where two individuals from contrasting cultures explore their connection through physical intimacy.

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Adonis, the only son of a marquess, is blessed with a handsome face, exceptional intellect, and a respectable family. However, his terrible personality has caused 23 noble ladies to break off their engagements with him so far.

In a desperate attempt to find someone who won't end the engagement, his mother chooses Ophelia, the daughter of a poor country noble, as his 24th fiancée. But Ophelia's bright personality and honesty soon melt the hearts of everyone in the marquessate, including Adonis himself...

(Source: Pocket Comics)

"Teresa... I'm sorry."

In the midst of a coup d'état, Princess Teresa finds she has been betrayed by her fiancé, Duke Marseille. After meeting her end at his hands, she wakes to find she's twelve years old again, and the coup has yet to take place! She quickly realizes that her family's oppressive rule is what leads to the revolt and makes the decision to change the course of fate. But will her newfound commitment to her people be enough to sway the duke's feelings?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Doesn’t every child dream of a world without grown-ups? But when a deadly virus wipes out everyone over the age of twenty, reality proves to be far more sinister than a childhood fantasy. By the time No-Eul turns eight, he is already familiar with the virus and the mysterious monsters that roam the land. When his mother passes away and his village comes under threat, he sets out on a journey to find "Utopia," a rumored safe haven said to hold the cure for the virus. But this so-called "Utopia" may not be what it seems...

(Source: WEBTOON)

191647.description:
An ugly duckling?!

Jouka Sourin Academy is a school for the sons and daughters of elite families, but the impoverished main character, Ug-Fatty Saotome, has been bullied there for six years. She's forced to face the leaders of the two bullying groups in the school, but luckily she has strong mental fortitude! Will she be able to survive the game her enemies have set up and graduate?

A romantic comedy featuring an Ug-fatty who fights back!

(Source: Pocket Comics)

191648.description:
Yui is 20 years old when she falls in love with someone for the first time. Hurt by trauma from her school days, she has no romantic experience to speak of. Now as she confronts friendship problems and love without any experience on her side, she faces tearful mistakes and misunderstandings. This is a slice-of-life love story about young people struggling to navigate romance like adults, but who still love like children.

Yoo-Joon is a good boy. That's why he was destined to fall head-over-heels for the handsome and charismatic Ji-Ho. When Ji-Ho says "Jump," Yoo-Joon asks "How high?" And as the pair become more inseparable by the day, they solidify their master-dog dynamic. But little do they know, each boy is harboring his own dark secret. Ji-Ho, who suffers from severe apathy resulting from childhood trauma, is using Yoo-Joon as an expendable toy, and Yoo-Joon is intensely and obsessively in love with Ji-Ho. Despite that, can the two boys successfully remove each other's masks and break the cycle of abuse?

Ukigaya is a lively man in his 40's who's decent at his job, single, and hasn't had a partner in years. One day he meets Shindo, an elite younger man who is incredibly good-looking. Their relationship is strained at best, as Shindo is always bossing him around and looking down on him. Upon noticing how attractive Shindo is, Ukigaya, who spent his youth seducing any attractive straight man he could get his hands on, wonders if he would have gone after him back in the day. Initially, he laughs off the thought. But what will happen to their relationship when he discovers Shindo's big secret? An age gap romance between a sharp-tongued younger man and an older former man-eater!

(Source: BookLive)

University student Itaru Hachimori obsessively stalks his crush, Yamato Mitsunaga. But Mitsunaga only has eyes for HIS own target, Hiromasa Tate. And Tate? He’s secretly stalking the one he likes...who turns out to be Hachimori?! A twisted love-hate triangle between three stalkers who attend the same university—disastrous for them, entertaining for onlookers!

(Source: Manga UP!)

And ever since her parents’ death, Jade’s family members have had their sights set on her claim to House Browen’s title as well as her life. Now that she’s been abandoned in a remote forest that nullifies all magic, she’s forced to rely on her mysterious rescuer, Axel. But as she tries to escape her predicament, the forest starts to unravel some dark past secrets...

Amane is good looking and good at his job. He hides his true personality, but he can speak his true feelings to his bad friend Sasaki from high school.
