title.native: だから僕たちはモテない

191671.description:
Aoi, a high school girl who keeps her true feelings to herself, gets caught in a dangerous situation while responding to her boyfriend's selfish request. Seki, the man who rescues her, blasts her with the question, "Are you stupid?" He also turns out to be the new homeroom teacher of her class! 
</br></br>
(Source: Flower Comics, translated)

191672.description:
At the slightest twitch to the brush of his delicate fingertips, a sharp thrill ran deep inside him, and it made him want to play a cruel little game. Without thinking about what that game might lead to.

“I want to touch you here, too.”

“...What?”

The man he thought knew nothing was no different from a beast.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes 16 extra chapters.

191674.description:
Yuri Sonagi is an unpredictable detective. Just when she was rejoicing over her first day off in two months, she ended up getting caught up in a kidnapping. What awaited her was the beginning of a mystery beyond her imagination. This is a police drama about a detective who breaks the mold and how she does as she pleases. Plus, who is the god of death and his unfathomable plan that connects to the multiple incidents of criminals killing themselves?

(Source: Pocket Comics)

191675.description:
Kozuya, the sales representative, wants to seal a contract with Takamori, the company doctor...so he can raise his marks and take his girlfriend on a luxurious date! ...But at that very moment, he's dumped by said girlfriend. Feeling depressed, the usually cold Takamori tags along with him to drink himself to oblivion... When he wakes up from his drunken state, he's somehow in bed with Takamori! "You're pretty hard even after drinking that much, aren't you?" It's his first time with a man, but it feels so good being penetrated by Takamori...

(Source: Mobile Media Research)

title.english: Affectionate Sex is Outside the Contract, Dr. Takamori!
title.native: 鷹森先生、溺愛えっちは契約外です！
title.romaji: Takamori-sensei, Dekiai Ecchi wa Keiyaku Gai desu!

191676.description:
Medical student Ruan Ruan was transformed into a rabbit spirit and met a cold and bloodthirsty fox. When they first met, she slipped and died under the opponent's knife. Unexpectedly, she would be resurrected with full health the next day. To survive in this fantasy continent with big bosses everywhere, Ruan Ruan decisively clung on the fox Qi Yang and became his loyal follower. Doing laundry, cooking, and coaxing people to sleep, the big boss going berserk and wanting to be smoothed out, and even becoming the other party's mobile blood bank on a full moon night, which really worries Ruan Ruan...

(Source: MangaToon)
synonyms: Black Male Master Raises Rabbit Online
闇堕ちキツネに飼われるウサギに転生しました

title.english: The Blackened Male Lead And Bunny Spirit
title.romaji: Heihua Nan Zhu Zaixian Yang Tu

191677.description: "Let's play badminton together forever," was their promise. Naruse and Hodaka have been a doubles pair since elementary school and are currently living together as a couple. After graduating from high school, Naruse continued playing badminton with a corporate team and Hodaka with the university badminton club. In contrast to Naruse, who expresses his pure feelings of wanting to play with Hodaka again soon, Hodaka is feeling his own limitations... They're close, but they can't communicate, and because they're close, they can't communicate. What answers will the two arrive at through their encounters with various people?

191678.description:
In order to escape the confines of life in the harem, Liang Jian travels a thousand years into the future. During an archaeological dig, the tomb of Emperor Sheng is unearthed, and his body is put on display in a museum. Hoping to finally sever his ties to the past, Liang Jian visits the museum to say his last goodbye to Sheng Mingzhou. But unexpectedly... Sheng Mingzhou is resurrected?!

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: The Demon Emperor Ex-Husband Has Resurrected

191679.description:
Top actor Lu Yi and rising star Gu Jiangyuan were known as rivals, until Lu Yi died in an accident. He wakes up 3 years later in the body of a shamed idol. Reborn, he discovers a shocking truth, Gu Jiangyuan has been in love with him all along. But things take a darker turn when ghost-hunting missions begin, and Gu Jiangyuan, cloaked in shadows and secrets, might be the one keeping him alive… or trying to end him for good.

(Source: Webnovel)

191680.description:
Happy, who grew up as a slave in the arena, has survived with monstrous skills. When the arena owner is executed, Happy is freed and meets new family and friends, gradually learning about society. However, the world did not give Happy the chance to stop fighting. As his identity, war on crime, and the secrets of his birth continue to intertwine, Happy becomes a being who goes beyond a monster and stands at the top of the world.

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: Happy Face: From Slave to Arena Legend

191681.description:
Ten years ago, Yeon-Ju left Eun-Seong, the man she loved, to protect his budding career. Now a stylist and devoted single mom to her son, Han-Byeol, she's shocked to learn that the lead actor of her next film is the very man she walked away from...

(Source: WEBTOON)

191683.description:
She was sent to spy on him. Falling for him was never part of the plan. Hye-Won Yun works tirelessly to secure her future, but loyalty comes at a cost. Vice President Ji-Seok Ha makes her track every move of his cousin, Executive Director Tae-Beom Ha. Tae-Beom knows she’s spying on him. But instead of pushing her away, he keeps her close. What begins as a cold arrangement shifts into something unpredictable. Their worlds were never meant to intertwine, but the more they fight it, the more inevitable it feels. Is it just proximity -- or something deeper?

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)
synonyms: ภารกิจรัก เลขายุน

title.native: いいこいいこってして
title.romaji: Ii Ko Ii Ko tte shite

191685.description:
Volume 1:
1. Eisei no Kaori (永世の香り); Towako 3
2-3. Eisei no Mai (永世の舞); Towako 4, 5
4. Eisei no Zhen (永世の鴆); Towako 6
5-6. Eisei no Gyou (永世の業); Towako 7, 8
7. Kaki Oroshi (描き下ろし)

Volume 2:
1-2. Eisei no Minamoto (永世の源); Towako 9, 10
3-5. Eisei no Kagami (永世の鑑); Towako 11, 12, 13
6. Eisei no Tsumi (永世の罪); Towako 15
7. Yokoku (予告)

title.native: 窓際編集とバカにされた俺が、双子JKと同居することになった
title.romaji: Madogiwa Henshuu to Baka ni Sareta Ore ga, Futago JK to Doukyo Suru Koto ni Natta

title.native: キャッチ・ザ・セント -花村牡丹の嗅覚捜査
title.romaji: Catch the Scent: Hanamura Botan no Kyuukaku Sousa

title.native: レンズの向こうの女神たち

191690.description:
In a world that's been nothing but unfair to them, Yoo Jin and Yegeon have found love with each other. However, love is not without its hardships. One is plagued by addictions to gambling and alcohol, while the other has a crippling fear of abandonment, making their time together anything but boring. Others may not understand their rocky relationship, but they have their own special way of working out their issues. Things may not be perfect, but love conquers all, doesn't it?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Part of RIDI's Natjyeobami Danpyeonseon (낮져밤이 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: [Day and Night Short Story Collection] Melting Home

191691.description:
Hikaru is a high school girl who is seriously injured by bullies and loses consciousness. When she wakes up, she's in a coliseum in another world as a sacrifice! Then, Hikaru awakens to the "talent for slaughter" that she had trapped deep inside her heart, which she never had a chance to use in her peaceful country.

(Source: Champion Cross, translated)

title.native: 少女は異世界で『殺戮の才能』に目覚める
title.romaji: Shoujo wa Isekai de "Satsuriku no Sainou" ni Mezameru

191692.description: Note: The compilation volume also contains the manga Sahoko Quest: Inkya Joshi, Shinshi Muke Doujin RPG Sekai de Yuusha ni Naru - BAD END.

title.native: さほこクエスト～陰キャ女子、紳士向け同人RPG世界で勇者になる～
title.romaji: Sahoko Quest: Inkya Joshi, Shinshi Muke Doujin RPG Sekai de Yuusha ni Naru

191693.description:
Go Han-Byeol, who has liked his older sister's best friend, Yun Ha-Neul, since childhood, enters the high school he had been looking forward to. He enters dreaming of a sweet school life with Ha-Neul hyung, but that Ha-Neul Hyung is dating his older sister!? On top of that, along with that news, Ha-Neul, who had been avoiding Han-Byeol, ends the high school he had been looking forward to so much. And 10 years later, due to a series of events, Han-Byeol and Ha-Neul meet again and hear the detailed story from 10 years ago...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

Note: Part of RIDI's Natjyeobami Danpyeonseon (낮져밤이 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: [Day and Night Short Story Collection] To the Stars

191694.description: Note: This manga is included in the compilation volume of Sahoko Quest: Inkya Joshi, Shinshi Muke Doujin RPG Sekai de Yuusha ni Naru.

title.native: さほこクエスト～陰キャ女子、紳士向け同人RPG世界で勇者になる～　BAD END
title.romaji: Sahoko Quest: Inkya Joshi, Shinshi Muke Doujin RPG Sekai de Yuusha ni Naru - BAD END

191695.description:
A decade ago, Chae Songhwa and her friend Seo Hyunwoo promised to meet again as their best selves. Unfortunately, life hasn’t quite turned out the way Songhwa imagined. So when they meet again at their high school reunion, Songhwa is stunned to find that Hyunwoo remembers her and wants to reconnect. One meal and a little too much wine later, he asks her to take him home, where the night takes a spicy turn. Are they simply spicing up their bland lives? Or is this the start of a delicious romance?

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Part of RIDI's Natjyeobami Danpyeonseon (낮져밤이 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: [Night Owl Anthology] Food First, First Love Comes Second
[Day and Night Short Story Collection] First Love After a Meal

title.native: セイ少女黙示録 ですぺあ
鬼嫁うららはメロらせたい

191698.description:
Kamiyain Fumi is a fierce middle-schooler who gambles on mahjong parlors at night while being a member of the mahjong club by day... Or so she wants others to think! Fumi has never actually gambled, but acted like one to impress her friends in the mahjong club; that backfires when Tendou Hinata, one of the weakest girls in the mahjong club, tries to emulate Fumi by actually gambling. Now indebted, Hinata asks Fumi to play in her place to make up her losses.
Fumi, unable to refuse, goes into the parlor at the time appointed by Hinata and discovers how frightening an actual gambling den is... Now, how will she keep her image and get out of there intact?
synonyms: Fumi Kamiyain aspires to become a BAKUTO!

title.native: 紙屋院文は博徒になりたい!
title.romaji: Kamiyain Fumi wa Bakuto ni Naritai!

191701.description:
Isabel lived and died as a doormat. After waking up in the past, she gets to work on dumping her terrible boyfriend and escaping her abusive household. However, financial and legal limits stop her from gaining total independence on her own. There is one potential solution: a policy that provides housing for newlyweds! This means Isabel has to find a man to marry. Enter Sir Dylan, the perfect catch. For reasons unknown, he volunteers to become her fake husband, and they earn Ishael’s dream house. But can they turn it into a real home together?

(Source: Tappytoon)
synonyms: My Dream Is to Get My Own House

title.english: All I Want is My Dream Home
title.native: 전 그냥 내 집 마련이 꿈인데요?
title.romaji: Jeon Geunyang Nae Jim Maryeoni Kkumindeyo?

title.native: 田舎暮らしの魔草薬師は返り咲く～不正はびこる元職場を解雇されたので独立したら、なぜか各界の超一流たちが集まってきました～
title.romaji: Inaka Gurashi no Masou Yakushi wa Kaerisaku: Fusei Habikoru Moto Shokuba wo Kaiko Sareta node Dokuritsu Shitara, Naze ka Kakkai no Chouryuu-tachi ga Atsumatte Kimashita

191703.description:
Yuna is always willing to step in and help out. So when nobody wanted to be Cinderella for the school festival play, she ends up taking on the role. The co-starring role is played by Minato Koga, a boy she’s barely spoken to. Her first impression of him was intimidating, but as they practice together, she starts to see his true self—

(Source: Betsuma, translated)

Note: Originally published in Bessatsu Margaret 2023 Nov. issue's BABY supplemental vol. 35.

title.native: 魔人学園グランギゴルガ

191705.description:
After a terrible accident left Seita hanging between life and death, it was Amé, a genius young inventor, who saved him...!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

title.native: グッドラックタイムマシン

191706.description:
After a life of neglect and a cold, loveless marriage to Duke Johann Leopold, Olivia Blanchett’s desperate attempts at love fail… until one day, Jian Han awakens in Olivia’s body. She seeks a divorce and flees to a rival kingdom, where she meets the charming but cunning Marquess Edgar Lancelot. Olivia is eager to start over and live her own life, all while her ex-husband secretly watches from afar. Will old flames be rekindled in this tale riddled with regret and revenge? Or will new love bloom?

(Source: WEBTOON)

title.english: The End of an Imperfect Divorce

191707.description:
The shaman “Manshin Kim Seo-Ryeong” of Yeongwoldang. The client “Noh Seung-Rae” who was born into a shaman family and lives rejecting the spirit rope, receives a request from Seo-Ryeong to visit her daughter who is blind. However, due to Seung-Rae’s attitude of not believing in shamanism and ignoring it, Seo-Ryeong does not accept the request and returns. However, from that day on, Seung-Rae’s past is reflected in Seo-Ryeong’s dreams. In the end, Seo-Ryeong follows Seung-Rae’s family…

The daughter of this family has an unusual aura?!

(Source: Naver, translated)

191708.description:
She was trained to kill. He was supposed to be the target. When assassin Yurian infiltrates the Argon Empire disguised as a princess bride, her mission is simple: murder Duke Larkan Blake on their wedding night and rescue her captive brother. But the notorious Duke is nothing like the monster she expected, and each night spent together makes it harder to carry out her revenge. Torn between duty and desire, will she choose love or vengeance?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: Put Your Sword Away in the Bedroom

title.english: Sheathe Your Sword in the Bedroom

191709.description:
A new chapter begins in the lives of this twisted couple.

(Source: Fakku!)

Note: Published in COMIC Kairakuten 2025-06, 07, 08, 09

title.english: The Moment Right Before Gloomy Types Start Dating is the Hottest, Ain't It?
title.native: 陰キャ同士の付き合う直前が一番エロいよね
title.romaji: Inkya Doushi no Tsukiau Chokuzen ga Ichiban Eroi yo ne

191710.description:
The story follows the serious and reliable Take, who is entrusted with his grandmother's pet cat upon her death. Instead of a cat, however, he discovers a Cat Demon.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: ぐ～たら猫またとおせっかい男子

191711.description:
A romantic comedy about a god who's been sulking for 200 years and a positive high school girl!

Yui, a high school girl who has been able to see spirits since she was a child, has a crush on a god who the spirits adore, even though she has never met him. She dreams of meeting him someday, but the god, who has been sleeping for 200 years after his fiancée ran away, finally wakes up...!

Yui immediately proposes to the god, but...!?

(Source: Flower Comics, translated)

title.native: ふて寝神様は花嫁様から逃げられない
title.romaji: Futene Kamisama wa Hanayome-sama kara Nigerarenai

191712.description:
There is also a thrilling mystery to solve!

Kai Kunieda is a bit of an oddball, but he is known as "Mr. Holmes" for his extraordinary powers of deduction. Kii Hosaka secretly has feelings for "Mr. Holmes". Kii became Kai's partner with her overwhelming feelings and enthusiasm, but it seems that she is only his partner for detective work, nothing more... Still, Himegi is not discouraged and strives to convey her feelings to Kai someday. Mysterious incidents are constantly occurring around the two of them...

They somehow manage to solve them with Kai's analytical skills and Himegi's initiative.

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: エックスイコール 〜Xは謎解きがお好き〜
title.romaji: X Equals: X wa Nazotoki ga Osuki

191713.description:
He is capricious, sometimes saying sweet things and other times being cold. With the help of her cat, she is finally going to conquer the boy who always teases her...

(Source: Sho-Comi, translated)

title.native: この恋、猫の手お借りします
この恋、猫の手お借りします

191715.description:
There is no such thing as coffee that never gets cold, and people's feelings change -- or so I thought. The sparkling, emotional cafe Junjoutan.

(Source: Sho-Comi, translated)

title.native: ご注文は冷めない恋で

191716.description:
One day, Kurose, an office worker, comes across a lost high school girl and feels he can't just leave her alone, so he brings her to his home. In truth, he fell for her at first sight, but because she's underage, he decides to hide his feelings. However, the girl is also keeping a secret from Kurose...

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: JKを拾った…と、思ったでしょ？
title.romaji: JK wo Atta... to, Omotta desho?

191717.description:
A romantic comedy about a lively college girl and a man with a complicated past. At a cozy izakaya run by her aunt, the girl works as the face of the shop and finds herself drawn to a quiet regular who always drinks alone. Unlike the other customers, he barely speaks and keeps to himself, but the way he genuinely enjoys his food leaves a strong impression. Though he’s caught up in some serious personal struggles, meeting her gradually starts to turn his life around for the better.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: ぼっちカラスのよりどころ

191719.description:
Wako (35), a woman born in the Showa era who has lived her life with drive and determination, and Wakana (23), a woman living in the Reiwa era who wants to achieve results smartly and with an emphasis on time. The two, who are complete opposites in common sense and work attitudes, meet as colleagues at a startup company where they change jobs. However, it turns out to be a terrifying black company where power harassment, sexual harassment, and monster employees are rampant...!!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: それってどうかと思います！〜転職女子、ブラック企業でサバイブする。〜
title.romaji: Sorette Douka to Omoimasu: Teshoku Joshi, Black Kigyou de Survival suru

191720.description:
Chinatsu Kasuga is a lively 20-year-old department store worker She has a relationship with Naka-chan, who is younger than her, where they are more than friends but not quite lovers. However, when she is transferred to the men's clothing department, she meets Takamura-san, a reliable and wonderful man. Younger men are cute, but women still admire older men.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

191721.description:
Saya, who is a history buff, and Katou, a foodie guy, met at a drinking party and somehow got along well, and recently they have been going out drinking together. The relationship between the two deepens over delicious food, and the story is carefully depicted as they progress step by step, unraveling their knowledge of history!

(Source: Kiss, translated)

title.native: 彼と彼女のヒストリごはん
title.romaji: Kare to Kanojo no History Gohan

191722.description:
A romantic comedy about a young lord, loved by his people for being a good ruler, and his childhood friend. Because his father taught him from a young age to fear witches, he’s made up his mind to kill any witch he finds. His childhood friend, who gets a strange thrill from seeing how scared he gets, starts pretending to be a witch just to mess with him. As he wrestles with the fear that she might really be a witch, their relationship grows more complicated. The story follows the ups and downs between them.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: こじらせ魔女ディエルダの憂鬱

191723.description:
"A new saga of blood, woven by father and sons."

During the 18th century, in Germany. HE, the beautiful son whom the Brecht Castle's master — Alois, is very proud of. HE does everything perfetly ever since HE can remember. Genius is the only word that can describe him.

Everything is going well and he thinks this happiness would last forever... Until He met that man...

A prequel manga for the multimedia franchise Carnelian Blood.
synonyms: カーネリアンブラッド

191724.description: At the beginning of Lin Fan's life, a sand world appeared, in which the biological cells unearthed from each sand tribe multiplied. He knew, that it would change the world…

191725.description:
In the era of the great Yin Dynasty, the famous minister Yan Xisheng and the leader of a martial arts sect, Sheng Yunqi, bear a striking resemblance to each other. Both were killed by their own disciples, but unexpectedly, they were reborn in each other’s body and must now teach each other’s disciples a lesson?!

Yan Xisheng: “I will learn from my past mistakes and surely be able to teach this ‘black lotus’ disciple properly.”

His crazy new disciple, Duan Wei: “Master, do you know what the first step is to tame a crazy dog?”

“Feed him until he’s full.”

(Source: Tencent, translated)
synonyms: Taming the Black Lotus Villain After Rebirth
ヤンデレ弟子を手懐ける
Taming The Black Lotus Villainous Disciple After Rebirth

title.native: 一日为师-重生后驯服黑莲花恶徒
title.romaji: Yi Ri Weishi: Chongsheng Hou Xunfu Hei Lianhua Etu

191726.description:
As a commoner, Bai Luo once made a childhood promise and became Prince Duan Chi Yan’s living antidote, sacrificing himself to neutralize the poison in Chi Yan's body. Yet Chi Yan misunderstood him and treated him with disdain.

Five years later, with the poison completely purged, Bai Luo, drained and broken, decides to leave. Though Chi Yan is unwilling to part, he stubbornly denies the love in his heart. In the end, Bai Luo is heartbroken, and the truth comes too late—Chi Yan is filled with regret!

When they meet again, Bai Luo has lost his memory and become cold and indifferent. Chi Yan bravely throws himself into a heart-wrenching, soul-crushing pursuit of love—a true “emotional crematorium” to win him back!

(Source: Kuaikan, translated)
synonyms: After My Death, the Prince Is Unbearably Grieved

191727.description:
You know him as the legendary Ranker, Urek Mazino—but once, he was just another Regular, climbing the Tower alongside both teammates and enemies. What awaits him after charging into the Tower, chasing after Phantaminum? Whatever it is he desires... will he find it there?

(Source: WEBTOON)
synonyms: 神之塔外傳：烏雷克·馬奇努
อูเร็ค มาซิโน่

191728.description:
Simon's sister asks him to boost his account because she's busy. But it turns out the guild his sister belongs to is for women only.

(Source: Toomics)

191729.description:
Jun-Ho, a perennial nerd, becomes friends with the kind and handsome Do-Yul, who takes classes in the same college. Jun-Ho falls in love with the affectionate and angelic Do-Yul. However, Do-Yul has a twin brother, Do-Ha, who is a brat, and Do-Ha begins to interfere with Jun-Ho and Do-Yul's relationship. When things don't go his way, Do-Ha disguises himself as Do-Yul and tramples on Jun-Ho's feelings, and even reveals his and his brother's secrets...

A love triangle romance between a man with multiple personalities who loves his own personality and a man who falls in love with two of those personalities.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
synonyms: ふたりの君に恋してます！

191730.description:
There's something bothering our main character, Reimi. And that's her extremely cheap and stingy sister-in-law, Kae-chan! Kae took home all the decorations from Reimi's wedding. During her baby shower, it seemed pretty obvious that Kae had just added her name to the present Reimi got from her husband's parents. And the gifts Kae actually did send for the baby were used and dirty... How stingy and cheap can a person be?! "It doesn't really matter..." "It's not worth bringing up..." At least that's what Reimi grit her teeth and told herself, but one day, Kae went one step too far...

(Source: K MANGA)

title.english: The Tale of How My Cheap, Stingy Sister-in-Law Lost It All
title.native: セコケチ義妹がすべてを失った話
title.romaji: Sekokechi Gimai ga Subete wo Ushinatta Hanashi

191731.description:
1-5, 9. Oman Control (おまんコントロール); ANGEL Club 2022-02, 04, 06, 08, 10, kaki oroshi
6-8. Haha no Mesugao (母の雌顔); ANGEL Club 2022-12, 2023-02,04

191732.description:
Yeo Eun-Seong has always been popular—too popular. With his striking looks, he attracts attention from everyone, regardless of age or gender. But constant gossip and misunderstandings have left him deeply distrustful of people. The last thing he needs is to be popular amongst ghosts too!

After moving into a new home for his job, Eun-Seong finds himself tormented by eerie paranormal activity night after night. One evening, while cowering outside his own apartment, he meets Seo Tae-Jeong, a passing office worker who—much to Eun-Seong’s surprise—can see and talk to ghosts. Desperate for peace, Eun-Seong enlists Tae-Jeong’s help to rid his house of its unwelcome guests. As the two work together, an unexpected and curious friendship begins to take shape… but is there more to Tae-Jeong than meets the eye?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes two side story chapters.
synonyms: ¿Por qué esta Casa es tan Barata
這裡房租怎麼這麼便宜？

191733.description:
The protagonist, Miyuki, lives happily with her husband, even though they share the same property. However, ever since her husband's childhood friend, Ikumi, who has returned home, has been staying with her parents-in-law, she has been acting as if she owns the place. In her husband's eyes, she tries to be superior. What's more, she decides to hold a birthday party for Ikumi's son at her parents-in-law's house, even though he's not her child! The hellish birthday party begins...

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

title.native: 夫の幼馴染が毒だった件。ーあなたの夫、返してくださいー
title.romaji: Otto no Osananajimi ga Dokudatta Ken. -Anata no Otto, Kaeshite Kudasai-

191736.description:
A dentist's life takes an unexpected turn when he encounters a sentient cavity bacteria...?! And somehow end up as family...?! From the brilliant mind of Momiyo Yamashita, creator of "Swipe Right and Die Tonight," comes an unpredictable cavity-themed comedy!

(Source: MANGA Plus)

191739.description:
Su-Ho, the youngest son of a noble family, is sickly and useless. After his miserable death, he is guided by a large, silver-haired man, Ryu-Seon. However, Su-Ho, who is excited by his overflowing strength unlike his life, climbs a tree and eats its fruit, but is bewildered when he fails to pass through the gate of reincarnation led by Ryu-Seon... Ryu-Seon kisses him, saying that he needs to remove the strong energy that has taken hold of his soul. But this feeling... is something... good?

(Source: Peanutoon, translated)

Note: Part of Peanutoon's Geosi,Girong Danpyeonseon (거시,기록 단편선) Collection.

One day, she saves a sick person on the train, and to her surprise, the person she saves is Juria, a boy who goes by “Hime” (princess)...! This is a reversed love comedy between a good-looking girl and a princess boy!
</br></br>

When Hyeon Weol realizes that he was inside the pages of a webnovel he had read, it's too late. But he's given a second chance and he's goal is to find the Seol Cheonyu, the dashing and dangerous main character.

(Source: Lalatoon)

Hanako always tries to dominate others. It started with her child's ballet class, then her clothes, nails, cars, social media... If you get fed up with Hanako and give your opinion, Hanako will try to dominate you even more. The other moms around her also give Hanako a hard time...

If you do something bad, you will get what you deserve!

A popular young boy and an older, average-looking boy find themselves entangled in an unexpected romance. Souta has been struggling with a stalker, so he decides to find a fake lover to deter them. The person who steps up is an extremely handsome guy. Holding hands, hugging, kissing—stealing all of Souta's firsts one after another, leaving his heart in turmoil. Before he knows it, he's swept away into bed! They aren't even lovers yet, but his new companion doesn't hold back his passion and desire for Souta at all...

(Source: Coolmic)

191751.description:
Senri's a simple and innocent college student who's way more into girls' comics than the average guy, and for some reason that makes his libido go wild. After getting injured and having to drop from the soccer team, he's been spending a lot of time alone without anywhere to let off some steam. That's when Senri's upperclassman comes in. Kyosuke: hot, devilish player, and good with words. One day, there's a drinking party for the club Senri's been joining in on lately, but right when Senri goes to the bathroom just to rub one off Kyosuke walks in on it all. Right when Senri's starting to think it's all over for him, two words break the silence: "Keep going."

(Source: MangaPlaza)

191756.description:
When I was suddenly summoned to another world by some mysterious identity that said, "Pick three skill seeds." But wait, what does "skill seeds" mean instead of just "skills"? Realizing the sole difference between the two, I awakened as the other world's first hacker capable of arbitrarily enhancing skills by manipulating their values! To start, I manipulated the skills of a beautiful girl, Mia, who suffered due to her skills being unsuitable for combat and joined forces with her to surpass those who had looked down on us!

(Source: Futabasha, translated)

191759.description:
Tae-Beom, the campus custodian, is a self-proclaimed expert at spotting - and "handling" - the sexually inexperienced. With a 100% success rate and dashing good looks, he sets his sights on Chae-Yi, a hunky physical education student who seems like the perfect target. But when his usual charms lead to a hilariously dramatic breakdown instead of a smooth conquest, Tae-Beom realizes he’s met his match. Now, the hunter becomes the pursuer as Tae-Beom chases the elusive Chae-Yi to protect his flawless reputation.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

191760.description:
After a once-dormant contract requiring descendants of House Morgana and House Kalakis to wed resurfaces, Meivia Morgana receives a shoddy proposal from the ever-miserable eldest son, Gilbert Kalakis. Determined not to settle for less, Meivia decides to marry the single and mysteriously alluring family head, Grand Duke Edis Kalakis. Between a volatile son always knocking at her door and an enticingly enigmatic father who leaves her wanting more, will Meivia be able to sign her way to happiness?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: Rather Than The Son, I’ll Take The Father

191761.description: Q-rais entertains a series of surreal night-time visitors to his apartment.

191762.description:
No one knows why these people are stranded here with death looming in the corner. As loneliness creeps in, it becomes all too easy to seek solace in others. But they must trust no one but themselves. Remember, the goal is to survive.

(Source: WEBTOON)

191763.description:
Waking up in a fantasy novel set in an ancient magical world was confusing enough for Sisha. But on top of that, she happens to be the only person who could read and understand the old texts recovered from the secret library kept hidden for thousands of years… Furthermore, to Sisha's surprise, the ancient language of forbidden magic turned out to be none other than modern English! With the emperor now praising her ability to decipher the words of Alphabet, Sisha steps up from a mere sidekick to an incredible main lead--in a world where whatever she speaks in her mother tongue is a key to unlock the powerful magic.

(Source: Pocket Comics)
synonyms: Sisha, experte de la langue de la magie
転生したら古代言語が韓国語でした

title.english: Only I Can Speak the Ancient Language of Magic

191764.description:
The one who bought the mysterious stone from his grandmother's house was... a former student from the school he's working at!?

(Source: Tokuma Shoten, translated)

191765.description:
A "military wife" is supposed to be an upper class person living in luxury in a resort overseas---!? Chika, who made her debut as a military wife by accompanying her husband Tadashi on his overseas posting, was supposed to live a glittering tropical life, but she was troubled by raising a child in a foreign country where she didn't speak the language, an uncooperative husband, and the local "military wife" community. "Why don't I just leave the housework to the maid?" says Emi, a celebrity wife, leaving her feeling uneasy. Fumie, a local wife, has a mysterious pregnancy.

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

title.native: 海外駐在妻の光と闇 シタ妻とサレ妻とサレかけた妻
title.romaji: Kaigai Chuuzaizuma no Hikari to Yami Shitazuma to Sarezuma to Sarekaketa

191766.description:
Riku Takayanagi is a boring 32-year-old businessman with nothing special about him. Or so it seems. In truth, he once saved another world as a hero.

Now he’s back in Japan, living a normal life… until one day, he’s dragged into the mess with three high school students and summoned again—this time to a different world?! Suddenly thrust into the unknown, Riku steadies the panicked teen heroes, encourages them, and teaches them how to survive.

The long-awaited opening to a second-chance another-world adventure—starring a caring, absurdly overpowered old man hero!

(Source: Alpha Manga)
synonyms: The Old Man in His Second Time in Another World Is Somehow Stronger than the High School Hero

title.english: Second Time in Another World, This Old Man Is WAY Stronger Than the High School Heroes!

191767.description:
Elaina, the illegitimate child of a count’s family and a cripple. She lives a lifeless existence, enduring the cold neglect of her family. Just before being sold off in a marriage deal to an old marquis, Elaina meets the "Monster Prince" Sinclair, who shows up with a marriage proposal in hand, saying he wants to marry her. Sinclair proposes a contract marriage, asking her to stay by his side only until he becomes emperor.

Contrary to the rumors, Sinclair is tsundere but also surprisingly caring, protecting her and worrying about her well-being. Elaina finds herself slowly drawn to him. But then... She begins to suspect that this prince might actually be Len— the boy from her childhood who was both her first love and the one who caused her to become crippled.

“Are you... really Len?”

(Source: Naver, translated)

191768.description: A brand new Godzilla manga, serialized in the seinen Manga magazine "Young Champion".

191769.description:
Based on the 2019 television drama adaptation of the original manga

Hiromi, a timid and quiet high-schooler, was forcefully raised by her grandmother. Due to her abuse, she created an imaginary version of herself in the mirror, named "Yumi," and would play by talking to her as a child. By the time Hiromi becomes a high school student, she only remembers playing with the mirror, but one day, she hears a voice coming from inside her reflection asking, "Is what Grandma says really right?"

Triggered by this voice, Hiromi's alternate personality freely controls Hiromi's body and ventures out into the night without Hiromi's knowledge...what sort of dangerous activities will "Yumi" force her timid host into, and what will become of this dynamic?

title.native: ヤヌスの鏡 タテマンガ

191770.description:
The manga centers on Jack, a middle-aged freight company employee, who suddenly becomes the key to defeating the demon king, when he is told that he is blessed with the strength of a legendary swordsman. He then decides to become an invincible swordsman as a side job.

(Source: Anime News Network)
synonyms: The Middle-Aged Deliveryman Becomes an Invincible Swordsman as a Side Job: After Leading a Lousy Life, I’m Now the Trump Card to Defeat the Demon King?

191771.description:
Aoi, who inherited the power to see "Ayakashi" from her late grandfather, is one day taken to "Tenjin-ya," a long-established inn in Kakurei, the world where Ayakashi live.

There, she is told that her grandfather once made a "certain promise" with the head of the demon god. The content of the promise was that "as collateral for his debt, he would give his granddaughter to the head of the demon god as a bride."

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

Udou, whose life revolves around money and success, ends up accompanying the eccentric prince, Uto, on his journey. However, he and Uda, the prince’s silent bodyguard, are a terrible match?!

(Source: Kobunsha, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

191773.description:
"It's always been you that I've wanted."

From an early age, Riko has been bullied for her crimson eyes, with people calling her "filthy" and "cursed by a monster." She marries Shuten-douji, a man-eater, in place of her sister, and heads to the mansion, prepared to die. But beneath the cherry blossoms, the demon stands, smiling---? Does the crimson eye reflect fear, or love? It's a tale of interspecies marriage, as fleeting as a dream.

(Source: Comic Days, translated)

What would you do with me in public?

Poisoners are seen all over the world, transforming themselves into ferocious monsters that harbor deadly poisons.What will their existence, called "Poisoners," bring to the world? A promising newcomer depicts on a grand scale in this powerful monster panic action film!

I just want a male mother! College student Song Fu, had 3 babies overnight and fell into a [child-rearing hell] — In order to solve this problem, he decided to hire a professional nanny. However, to his surprise, the person knocking on the door turned out to be a [Super tall, muscular bodied] man?!

Full of youthful vigour, this is a comic with BL and sports theme. BL~ BL! Here is the concentration campus for fujyoshi, jiggle r-ring!

191781.description:
The peak of happiness in love is... the moment you start dating?! Of course, everything would start to seem like a sign of a breakup!! Enter a scorching hot BL couple!! Yamoto and Seo have just embarked on their romantic journey. Initially drawn together by Seo's irresistible allure, Yamoto, who has a track record of breakups as swift as 10 days after dating, finds himself unable to fully embrace the romance, lamenting, "It only goes well until you start dating!" To complicate matters further, Seo seems hesitant to make any advances... Resigned to an inevitable end, Yamoto decides to take matters into his own hands and seduce Seo! But Seo harbors a secret... As the fear of losing something precious intensifies, will they overcome their insecurities and remain together?!

(Source: Coolmic)

191782.description:
Nanahoshi, who has an unrivaled love for rice, one day could no longer eat his beloved white rice due to a trauma. When he was deeply troubled, he met his neighbor, Yumewaka, who claimed to be able to erase the memory of the trauma. Although Nanahoshi was skeptical, through Yumewaka's suggestion, the memory was truly erased! However, due to Nanahoshi's stubbornness, he soon remembered it again. Together with Yumewaka, they tried various methods, and what Nanahoshi discovered was──"Won't you touch me?"
Overcoming trauma with a neighbor who can erase memories through suggestion...

(Source: Printemps Shuppan, translated)

A male Ero RPG fan's life is flipped upside down when he gets TS (transexual) reincarnated in another world!

191787.description:
After global warming destroyed the Earth, humanity set off for the uncharted planet paradise known as "Arcadia." Crew member Yeongsu Dong wakes up from stasis to find himself the lone survivor, orbitting the planet in the debris field of the wrecked ship. He gets to the surface, where he is immediately attacked by wild creatures, and gets caught in the civil war among the native Arcadians. He must learn to communicate and survive in this strange new world, and find a way to stop an apocalyptic comet set to destroy his new home.

(Source: WEBTOON)

191789.description:
"I want many more people to recognize your talent and appeal."

Orihara takes pride in Narikawa, the actor whom he manages. Narikawa is wary of strangers and distrustful of other people, but he has a pure heart, and his incredible acting skills set him apart from other young actors. While supporting him closely as a manager, Orihara begins to grow fond of him; finally, he agrees to help relieve certain physical urges for Narikawa. From then on, Narikawa's attachment to Orihara grows deeper day by day, until...? A quiet, but intense romance between a clumsy actor and his older manager.

(Source: MangaPlaza)

synonyms: Wild Beast Tamer and the Lost Child

191792.description:
After-hours paperwork isn’t the only thing heating up at BL Corporation.

From HR to R&D, Secretarial to Marketing, a group of college friends all find themselves working under the same roof—and tangled in office romances no one saw coming. Whether it’s a shy developer revealing an unexpected secret, a longtime friend pushing the boundaries of “just colleagues,” or a bold assistant making a move that’s way above their pay grade, each story proves that love in the workplace is rarely by the book. Four departments. Four love stories. One HR nightmare waiting to happen.

(Source: Lezhin US)

1-5. Gaebal Team (개발팀, Backend Development) [Dae Namueun x Samdukong]
6-10. Marketing Team (마케팅팀, Bedroom Strategy) [Dimang x Gugu]

191795.description:
Kwon, known as the warrior who protects Goryeo. His story begins from his childhood. The protagonist Kwon and his older brother Jeong are the sons of Manjeok, the strongest warrior and a slave in Goryeo. Their father Manjeok started a slave liberation movement, but it ended in failure, and he met his death. After that, Jeong and Kwon are constantly targeted by people trying to take their lives. While hiding to survive and training in his father’s martial arts, one day, his brother is killed in an attack by masters, and Kwon barely survives. While fleeing, he loses consciousness, and when he finally wakes up, Kwon finds himself in a Song Dynasty martial arts arena. Not just any arena, but one where the entire region is a fighting ground, and only the strong survive. Determined to avenge his brother, Kwon resolves to become stronger in this brutal place. He vows to become the strongest and return to kill those who wronged him.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

191797.description:
In a world of superpowered heroes and villains, villain Peridot and hero Jackal strike a deal: Peridot pretends to be Jackal’s puppet in public to help boost his rank, and in return, Jackal shelters him. But Jackal’s growing obsession hints at a shared, hidden past…

(Source: Manta)

"Candy," a mysterious drug whose main ingredient is just ordinary sugar, is spreading like wildfire in Tokyo. When Susui, a narcotics agent who has infiltrated the yakuza to get closer to Candy's manufacturer, finds himself in danger, a self-proclaimed "magical girl" named Riri Hoshina comes to his rescue...!

Matsuri no Naka no Kinki Nite

Mitsuhara Natsuno, the manager of the sales department who is feared by those around him for his intimidating looks, is actually gay and a virgin. He secretly has a desire to be held by a man. One day, he decides to post an erotic selfie on a gay site, but his junior, Komaki Itsuki, finds out.

"Do you want me to not tell anyone about this? If so..."

he half-forcefully drags him to a hotel!

An erotic love comedy BL between a secretly sadistic and obsessive junior and a secretly masochistic manager!

(Source: Comico, translated)

Late at night, a moaning sound is heard in the office of GPSP (Gaepalja Sangpalja), a social media for dogs. Seo-Jun, the owner of the strange voice, consoles himself with the clothes of Tae-San, the person he has a crush on, sitting next to him, and spits out words that sound like lamentations about his life. "I wish I had been born a dog." And the next morning, Seo-Jun has become a dog.

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

"It isn't the strongest who survives. The one who survives is the strongest."

After being discharged from the military, Jin Seowoon did nothing but play games like a loser. One day, he was invited to the world of "Cloyd Survival," which resembled a game he enjoyed. In that world were masters of martial arts, kings from other worlds, and notorious killers... It was a gathering of monsters that surpassed human imagination. Jin Seowoon had just one objective—to survive and become one of the top ten. Here lies a tale of survival with Jin Seowoon's life at stake.

(Source: Naver, translated)
synonyms: 異世界バトロワ生存記

All she wanted was an easy life as a noble woman. Instead, Laura Jay found herself involved with a series of drama and a number of courters. She didn't sign up for all the excitement. "Just leave me alone!"

(Source: WEBTOONS)

The Villainess Is Bothered by the Male Leads Again Today

title.english: The Villainess is Bothered By Male Leads

191822.description:
The Avians are said to be descendants of a great and powerful flying beast. Unfortunately, the gifts bestowed upon the Avians have regularly put them at war with the human empire. When a failed attack on the palace leaves the hybrid Vio in captivity, he meets Lou, the illegitimate princess of the empire. Can these two "half-breeds" bridge the gap between their species?

(Source: Tapas)

title.native: 薬剤師・毒島花織の名推理
title.romaji: Yakuzai-shi Busujima Kaori no Mei Suiri

191824.description:
While driven in her life and supported by loving parents, Mihyang Kim has been a sidekick, shadowed by her childhood friend, Shiyeon. When both of them suffer a fatal accident, Mihyang is reborn as Damia, and Shiyeon is reborn as Eileene in a new fantasy world.Surprisingly, their new lives as Nobles and Socialites in this new world mirror their lives back in Korea, and Damia drives herself to find her own path in life, escaping the shadow of her long-time friend. However, with Eileene caught in a web of royal politics and a large conspiracy slowly revealing itself in the kingdom, Damia must find a way to help her friend, and survive this new world herself!

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

Note: First released in English, with the initial eligible release in Japanese followed by Korean, making it a manga by our standards.
synonyms: Donnez un peu d'amour aux seconds rôles

title.english: Supporting Characters Also Need Some Love

191825.description:
With the start of senior year, high schooler Lee Yoeng-Won can't wait to graduate and leave his life of poverty behind. He only has to focus on studying so he can get into a good college. But suddenly, Mr. Popular, Yu Seon-U, who was never close to Yeong-Won, starts buying him food, helps him become class president, and even walks him home. Though Yeong-Won knows his top priority should be his grades, he begins to wonder why Seon-U is always the subject of his gaze...

(Source: Tapas, edited)

191826.description:
The spinoff manga centers on Nanako Tadano, an office worker who died from overwork, and is reincarnated as Nanashi in another world similar to her favorite anime, Queen's Blade Legend. Nanashi accidentally frees a legendary monster and becomes a beautiful fighter with the most powerful skill. But in the world of beautiful fighters where everything is decided with harsh duels, Nanashi decides to hide her great power and just watch the great duel battles between her favorite characters.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: ナナシの転生クイーンズブレイド

191827.description:
Despite his terrible luck in life, Ted was a top livestreaming musketeer in the fully immersive VR game, "Face Chronicle." But his bad luck made him stumble upon a conspiracy where major guilds were illegally taming boss monsters to get ahead. They were far from happy when Ted threatened to expose them, so they coerced him into deleting his game character, which forced him to start over. Can Ted turn his luck around by starting all over from level one? Or will his bad luck ruin his last shot?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: 人生かけて運強化に全振り
Putting My Life on the Line, I Go All-in on Luck Enhancement

191828.description:
The story of the spinoff novel follows the Kuroba twins, who are sworn to protect Tatsuya Shiba. They face a new threat when an enemy from a foreign mafia sets eyes on Tatsuya.

(Source: Anime News Network, edited)
synonyms: The Irregular at Magic High School: The Dark Flashes in the Night's Veil

title.native: 魔法科高校の劣等生 夜の帳に闇は閃く
title.romaji: Mahouka Koukou no Rettousei: Yoru no Tobari ni Yami wa Hirameku

191829.description:
Boss raids are an amazing opportunity for hunters. That’s why Gun-Woo Lee agreed right away when he was asked to join. An intense battle ensued, but Gun-Woo and his guild mates got the Boss’s health down to 30 percent. However, that triggered an effect, and now the Boss is about to explode in three minutes. Gun-Woo and his guild mates sense that they won’t be able to defeat the Boss in time, so they decide to escape. As they were about to get out, Gun-Woo was betrayed and trapped inside the dungeon…

(Source: Tapas)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

Tsukasa thinks her move to the big city will help her get over her crush on her childhood friend Makoto... but he's joining her! And she's been having spicy "dreams" about him...

191839.description:
Only music sustained me from the maddening pain. If only I could hear my music... with my own ears... Even as my soul was falling apart, I prayed to God... and prayed again. Ludwig van Beethoven, considered the greatest composer in human history, closed his eyes like that. And 180 years later in Seoul. The saint of music, known as an immortal genius, has been reborn. And then he began to hear the voice of an angel. "Dobin... Dobin..."

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

191840.description:
100 Miles. 160.9344 kilometers, a ball that any pitcher would want to throw.

"Why do you like baseball?"

To me, baseball is simply myself. While dedicating himself to harsh practice and his bright youth, the boy stood on the mound.

This is the story of a man who dreams of becoming the best pitcher in history.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

191841.description:
[Unique Trait ‘Skill Master (EX)’ has been activated.]

▶ ‘Skill Copy (EX)’ is now enabled.

“Whoa… your skill’s insane!”

[Skill has been copied.]

From now on, there’s no skill he can’t have. Yours is mine. Mine? Still mine. The rise of the ultimate cheat-class protagonist begins now. All Skill Master Yoo Ju-yeon’s explosive saga is just getting started!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
synonyms: Skill Collector: The Ultimate Skill Thief

191842.description:
Cavil Sernua is the bastard son of House Sernua and the male lead of this story. His story begins in an orphanage, but he soon grows up to be a respectable figure who's loved by all. The villainess is Cavil's wife, Elodi McClaire, the character I transmigrated into. Elodi is cruel and evil, and she met her tragic ending in the book. However, I will not follow in her footsteps. Instead, I will raise Cavil well and divorce him so he can end up with his true love. Well, that is... if he'll let me.

(Source: Tapas)

191843.description:
Ritsu, dumped by his boyfriend, is fueled by alcohol to drown out his misery. On a drunk impulse, he gets tangled up with Satomi who happened to be sitting next to him. As Satomi tries to soothe him, Ritsu defiantly asks him this: “in that case, would you sleep with me?" Ritsu regains his senses when they reach the hotel, but Satomi's raring to go. His heart is laid bare under Satomi's passionate gaze… his hips penetrate Ritsu, feeling him deep inside… Thinking it was a one-night stand, Ritsu allowed himself to drown in the pleasure. A tender, sexy, mature love filled with erotic nights.

(Source: Mobile Media Research)

title.english: The Two of Us in the Night
title.romaji: Yoru ni Midara na Bokutachi wa

191844.description:
Three months into their relationship, Miyako suddenly realized something. That was...
“We haven't done anything but have sex since we started dating, have we!?”
Looking back, they were only having sex every time they met. Could they really be called lovers? Miyako began to feel uneasy about his relationship with Azuma...

Note: Includes an extra chapter.

191846.description:
"I cursed you with one command: live."

Born into the bloodline destined to lead the fierce and war-loving Raiveda Clan, Giz has always carried a single ambition: to free Tzad, a retired warrior held captive as little more than a plaything on the outskirts of the settlement. To everyone else, Tzad is a disgraced veteran. To Giz, he is far more: a trusted comrade who fought beside him for years, the only person who ever stood as his equal, and the one who quietly claimed a place in his heart.

But before Giz can reveal the truth of his feelings, tragedy strikes. Just as he stands on the verge of inheriting the chieftain's seat, Tzad murders one of the clan's most powerful elders, shattering their future in an instant. Branded a criminal and sentenced to death, Tzad becomes the enemy of the very people he once protected. With the tribe demanding blood and destiny pulling them to opposite sides, Giz must choose between the future he has spent his life pursuing and the man he cannot bear to lose.

(Source: Crossed Hearts)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: The Bird in the Cage Dreams

191847.description:
The manga's story begins with an indiscriminate slaughter at a cafe frequented by young people. Security camera footage shows an unarmed man with shaven head, able to seemingly kill people with a simple touch. Police investigation leads to the suspected identity of the murderer: middle-aged man named Tarō Yamada. When the police conduct a search of his apartment, they find the rotting corpse of a woman.

(Source: Anime News Network)

191848.description:
Selection of short stories written and illustrated when the author was between the ages of eighteen and twenty. Several stories were selected from "Pippyu", a collection published by Bronze Shinsha in 1979, and from "Bara no Kobeya ni Yuri no Yadai", another collection published by Kubo Shoten in 1981. All the stories were published in various seinen magazines between 1977 and 1979.

191851.description:
Have you ever pretended you were good at sports to impress your crush? Enter high school student Haemin Oh, who desperately wants to catch the attention of Ina Jeong, recently elected president of the school swimming club. Ina is recruiting, and despite barely knowing how to float, Haemin somehow ends up making her think that he’s an expert at the sport. Before long, Haemin has to prove himself in the lane. Sink or swim, it’s time to make a splash!

(Source: WEBTOON)

191852.description:
A college dinner. A drunken early morning with friends. It was a day no different from any other day, but when I opened my eyes, I found myself being delivered to me by a man.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

191853.description:
The suspense manga centers on Sousuke Yamada, who has a loving wife and an elementary student daughter. Sousuke happens to see a video from an "Ura Aka" (secret SNS account) of a woman, who appears to be his wife, having sex with another man. Additionally, the video was taken at her daughter's school. Sousuke tries to find the truth by attending the school's PTA meeting with his wife.

(Source: Anime News Network)

191854.description:
In order to pay off his mother’s crushing debt, Woo Min-Jo finds himself delivering coffee in high heels to a construction firm run by the notorious gangster, Chu Gio. What starts as a misfortune spirals into a bizarre fate, as Gio quickly takes an interest in Min-Jo. And before he knows it, Min-Jo goes from a broke errand boy to the unlikely “bride” of a thug...!

(Source: Tappytoon)

title.english: Love Me Like You Owe Me

191855.description:
Shaoran (Xiaolian) is an orphaned girl who lives alone in the mountains at the very nook of an impoverished village. One day, an envoy from the palace arrives and scouts her to to be a lady-in-waiting for the imperial harem. This was how a wild girl raised on the mountains was able to live in a luxurious palace working as a lady-in-waiting, however...

On her first day (due to various reasons), Shaoran had suddenly become a criminal after slapping one of the consorts.

Though execution appeared certain, she was specially pardoned and demoted from a lady-in-waiting to a maidservant in charge of odd jobs. She is ridiculed by the other consorts as the, "Princess of Odd Jobs," however, this is where her rapid advance begins. She implements reforms to the worn-down palace and optimizes her chores through the knowledge she learned from her life of living in poverty, earning the gaze of the other ladies-in-waiting and the imperial consorts alike. Continuing these course of events, Shaoran's name spreads through the imperial palace, reaching even the emperor's ears...

(Source: Shousetsuka ni Narou, translated)
synonyms: The Chore Princess of the Inner Palace
後宮の雑用姫　～山育ちの知恵を駆使して宮廷をリフォームしたり、邪悪なものを狩ったりしていたら、何故か皇帝達から一目置かれるようになりました～

191856.description:
A prodigy of science and a solitary genius—yet terrible at so many things!?

When the poor university student Sanosuke Saraki started at a new part-time job at his old high school, he unexpectedly reunites with Koharu Kobachi, a classmate that he admired as a brilliant genius. However, this supposed genius is now a "5th year high school student" who must repeat her senior year for the second time…! Saraki's mission is to "help Koharu graduate by the end of the year." A coming-of-age story about starting over with a 20-year-old high school student!

191859.description:
"Even if I eat poison three times a day instead of rice, I won't die?"

No matter how hard he tries, he won't die, the immortal saint. Finally succeeded in dying... I thought it was just a day, but he turned out to be a third-rate bodyguard of Han Gi-Ru in Shandong Province? But his powerful internal energy from the past is still dormant within him. The endless strife in the martial arts world, the secret struggles of the princes surrounding the throne, and the evil Taoist path acting secretly behind it all. The third-rate bodyguard Cheongpung stands against all this chaos.To make matters worse, enemies with whom he had a grudge from the past begin to show up one after another, and the confusion reaches its peak. Will he be able to regain the martial arts skills from his days as a saint and finally reach nirvana?

In 2025, the grand drama of the imperial palace that tears the martial arts world apart begins!!

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)

191862.description:
Gyu-Rye, a second-year student at Yeonriji High School. He is at an age where he should be interested in love and good alarms, but what Gyu-Rye wants most is a lottery ticket to escape from a family that does not pay attention to him. Is he trying to grant his wish? One day, two people appear in front of Gyu-Rye. A game buddy and affectionate son, and a boy who claims to be Han Kang-Rin's childhood friend and makes him feel bad, Ok So-Han. One of these two is a lover from a past life 70 years ago who has a 'shield', and the other is an avenger who has a grudge from a past life with a 'spear'.

A story of three people's entangled relationships that have continued for over 70 years, with their memories of past and present lives mixed up in a mess.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)
synonyms: The Lower Part of the Green Color

191863.description:
Haechan dreams of becoming a hero, saving Korea from the deadly Calamities. But as a powerless guard, he is seen as a weakling. That is, until he meets Miro, a mysterious girl who offers him immense power in exchange for his help in destroying the sacred Seal Talismans—the true source of the Calamities’ wrath. Now, Haechan must embark on a dangerous mission to free the world from its torment, all while living a double life filled with secrecy, betrayal, and a growing conflict between heroism and villainy.

(Source: WEBTOON)

191864.description:
Although she admires the rock bands she saw as a child, Yoshino Nakagawa is too shy to sing in front of others. Her classmate Futaba Shirase sees her singing secretly in a toilet stall and invites her to form a band together. The story begins when this happens. Luna Fujimori quits the light music club to join the band, wanting to see the friendship between the two up close, and Kanae Sakanoshita is invited to play the guitar just to make up the numbers, but as she starts playing it, she falls in love with it. This is a story of youth and friendship spun by these unique members.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

title.native: ガールズフィスト!!!! GT

191865.description:
To treat his sensitivity issues, Do-Won agrees to be part of the blindfolded kissing booth at the school festival. He thought he’d only get a few meaningless pecks, but ends up making out with a mysterious guy whose kiss is so intense, it makes him hard! Do-Won becomes obsessed with finding the other man, but he never imagined it’d be Jun-Hyeon, the otaku nerd from school who's a total jerk! Will Do-Won be able to accept that his body reacts to this nerd, or will Jun-Hyeon's secretly sexy side be his undoing?

(Source: Lezhin US)

191866.description:
Dante has lived his life hiding a secret—he is immortal. Working as a repairman, he one day witnesses a murder at the home of his client, Demis. Instead of running, he makes an unusual request: Kill me. Demis refuses at first, but upon discovering Dante’s immortality, he becomes intrigued. A dangerous promise is made—one that ties them together in a fate neither of them could have foreseen.

(Source: Lezhin US)

191867.description:
Kwon Joo-Hyuk and Lee Chae-Ha, who have been in love for five long years. The two people who got bored couldn't change their decision to break up even with their last farewell trip. However, on the way back from the trip, they meet an unexpected accident... Lee Chae-Ha, now 32 years old, returns to the place where he first met Kwon Joo-Hyuk five years ago. And there, he gets entangled with Kwon Joo-Hyuk, who asks him, "Didn't you bring me to the motel because you wanted to do it with me?" right before meeting him...

(Source: BookCube, translated)

One day, a villain appears in a peaceful city. Tate, who was suffering from overtime work today, hides the villain who was being chased by the hero, but when the hero appears, he sees the villain getting strangely excited and makes a proposal…

Ki-Heon Woo, a phony medicine salesman, appears in a rural village. He is a seemingly innocent rural alpha bachelor who has become a resident of the Bible's house, and while he's at it, he's also sold out of his phony medicine! But this guy eats all the medicine in one day and then he goes into a coma...?

On the day of his release from prison for murder, Yo-Han Lee's younger brother, Hyun, who has become a lawyer, appears in front of him. However, Yo-Han Lee keeps rejecting his younger brother who says he will clear his name. Why do you keep avoiding me, hyung? Just because we are not real blood relatives?

Ezio had a one-night stand with a man named Heisi. I'm going to catch Heisi Rinotti!

Kang Tae-Shin, an idol-turned-actor whose character is always controversial, and Ban Han-Seo, a popular child actor with a face that is building up a good story. The two were secretly dating... That is, until 6 years ago. One day, when Kang Tae-Shin's assault incident broke out, Ban Han-Seo, as the sole witness, asked to have a relationship in exchange for covering up the scandal...

"I didn't know you would really have sex with me, Tae-Shin."

(Source: BookCube, translated)

191878.description:
Go Yi-Young, a mystery game enthusiast, is walking down the street while leaving a review for the popular mystery game The Sin of the Blue Silhouette when he fails to avoid a bicycle and gets hit by it. When he regains consciousness, he realizes that he has entered the mystery game he was playing just a moment ago, and in order to survive, he tries to prevent the murder of the culprit he saw in the game, Cha Gyeon-Woo...

Do-Ha never expected to run into his childhood crush, Hwa-Soo, again. Turns out he's living right next door. But wait, he’s married? And has a daughter? Maybe this isn’t meant to be. No, scratch that. He’s divorced. Sweeeett!! Looks like fate just handed Do-Ha a second chance. And damn, Hwa-Soo still looks amazing. That quiet sadness makes him even more irresistible. Divorced? The beautiful girl chose to die while still young and beautiful. A girl who was hostile. The girl I longed for. The girl who compared. A girl who imitated. The girl who worshiped. “Misol, take it off. Let me be the one to really see you.”

But things spiral further when Chawon’s bold friend, Jang Taegun, joins in, grinning as he growls:

title.romaji: Urakata Chara no Aoki-kun ga Love-Come wo Seisu Made.

title.native: おっさん異世界で最強になる ～物理特化の覚醒者～
title.romaji: Ossan Isekai de Saikyou ni Naru: Butsuri Tokka no Kakusei-sha

191991.description:
The otherworldly gourmet fantasy story centers on a navy admiral who is considered a hero known as the Sword of Alba. His country sends him to study at a military academy, but after meeting a fairy along the way, he ends up at an elven academy instead. He adapts to his environment and ends up cooking for young children there.

(Source: Anime News Network)
synonyms: Hero's Second Life: But It Might Be Fun to Cook for Kids

title.native: 英雄その後のセカンドライフ　しかし子供に料理を振る舞うのは楽しいかもな
title.romaji: Eiyuu Sonogo no Second Life: Shikashi Kodomo ni Ryouri wo Furumau no wa Tanoshii kamo na

191992.description:
Seong-Chan, who became a bankrupt while carrying his father's debt, ends up working at a 'slave concept gay bar' because his debt does not go down no matter how much he works. There, he meets the owner, Ji-Hoon, and opens his eyes to a new kind of play...

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Note: Part of Bomtoon's Kkulman Danpyeonseon (꿀맛 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: [Honey Tasty Short Story Collection] Secret Take

191993.description:
Young Mary fell into the sea. At the moment when his consciousness faded, he saw a dazzling silver-haired man. Was he the one who saved him? He couldn't forget that image. He looked exactly like the mermaid princess in the fairy tale. From that day on, Mary became obsessed with mermaids. In order to create a mermaid just like the man he saw as a child, he ended up going to a human auction house...

"Why did you buy me...?"

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Note: Part of Bomtoon's Kkulman Danpyeonseon (꿀맛 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: [Honey Tasty Short Story Collection] Mermaid Syndrome

191995.description:
Ji-Han, a doctor who specializes in treating patients, meets a new patient, Lee Hyun, who is full of problems. Their first meeting was not so good, but as they continue to receive mysterious treatments, the two become closer. Ji-Han gives Lee Hyun, who longs to go out, a drug that is still under development, and Lee Hyun, who sneaks out in the middle of the night, gets caught by a mysterious person...

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

Note: Part of Bomtoon's Kkulman Danpyeonseon (꿀맛 단편선) Collection.
synonyms: [Honey Sweet Anthology] Song of Dog and Bird

191996.description:
The manga's story is set during the end of the world, where people still need clothes, food, and shelter to live. What is the worth of clothes in a world where people need adequate food to survive?

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: 世界の終わりの洋裁店
酒のほそ道～コラボ＆リメイク～

191998.description:
Ethan, an author of children's books, travels to a coastal village rumored to be home to mermaids in search of inspiration for a new story. After an unexpected fall into the sea, he stumbles upon a mysterious pearl—one that grants him the ability to breathe underwater. Excited by his discovery, Ethan eagerly plans to use it as the basis for his next book. But that night, the true owner of the pearl emerges from the depths. The mermaid forcefully claims what is his—and offers Ethan a deal he can’t refuse…

(Source: Lezhin US)

191999.description: A very short oneshot about a young transgender girl who is bullied at school but accepted by her older sister.
synonyms: The Story of a Boy Who Wants to Be a Girl

title.native: 女の子になりたい男の子の話
